target_text: WHO recommended that health teams map referral options for dialysis, maternity care, and trauma treatment.

source_text: WFP berkoordinasi dengan penyedia pengangkutan tempatan selepas kapasiti trak komersial menjadi kekangan operasi utama.
target_text: WFP coordinated with local transport providers after commercial trucking capacity became a major operational constraint.

source_text: ISCG menyatukan keperluan sektor supaya penderma dapat membandingkan jurang mendesak tanpa membaca laporan teknikal berasingan.
target_text: The ISCG consolidated sector needs so donors could compare urgent gaps without reading separate technical reports.

source_text: USAID BHA menyemak sama ada aktiviti yang dicadangkan merangkumi koordinasi dengan pihak berkuasa tempatan dan garis masa penghantaran yang realistik.
target_text: USAID BHA reviewed whether proposed activities included coordination with local authorities and realistic delivery timelines.

source_text: Pemerhati ADMM-Plus menyatakan bahawa prosedur bersama meningkatkan kepercayaan sebelum tekanan operasi meningkat semasa senario.
target_text: ADMM-Plus observers noted that common procedures improved trust before operational pressure increased during the scenario.

source_text: EWG on HADR mencadangkan latihan semula yang lebih kerap untuk koordinasi logistik multinasional semasa latihan serantau.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended more frequent rehearsal of multinational logistics coordination during regional exercises.

source_text: Pengurusan worksite INSARAG mengurangkan kekeliruan apabila beberapa pasukan penyelamat tiba di struktur runtuh yang sama.
target_text: INSARAG worksite management reduced confusion when multiple rescue teams arrived at the same collapsed structure.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat menyimpan rekod rasmi keputusan untuk tindakan susulan semasa mesyuarat HADR serantau akan datang.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved the official record of decisions for follow-up during future regional HADR meetings.

source_text: Peserta AMRG on HADR meneliti sama ada unit yang boleh dikerahkan mempunyai self-sustainment yang mencukupi untuk operasi terpencil.
target_text: AMRG on HADR participants examined whether deployable units had enough self-sustainment for remote operations.

source_text: Pasukan SAF berkongsi pengalaman tentang mengintegrasikan perancangan pemindahan perubatan dengan prosedur penerimaan lapangan terbang.
target_text: SAF teams shared experience on integrating medical evacuation planning with airfield reception procedures.

source_text: Jurutera PLA meminta data tinjauan tempatan sebelum mengerahkan peralatan ke lintasan sungai yang rosak.
target_text: PLA engineers requested local survey data before committing equipment to the damaged river crossing.

source_text: JOCCA membantu mengenal pasti bila tawaran serantau harus dialihkan kerana keperluan asal telah dipenuhi.
target_text: JOCCA helped identify when a regional offer should be redirected because the original need had already been met.

source_text: Pengajar SCDF menyemak protokol komunikasi penyelamatan teknikal dengan pasukan tempatan sebelum latihan malam.
target_text: SCDF instructors reviewed technical rescue communication protocols with local teams before the night exercise.

source_text: VINASARCOM menyelaraskan kelulusan nasional supaya rakan kongsi antarabangsa tidak berunding secara berasingan dengan beberapa wilayah.
target_text: VINASARCOM coordinated national approvals so international partners would not negotiate separately with multiple provinces.

source_text: Kemas kini VDDMA membantu perancang pemindahan menjangka kawasan rendah mana yang boleh banjir semula selepas pelepasan empangan.
target_text: VDDMA updates helped evacuation planners anticipate which low-lying areas could flood again after dam releases.

source_text: Sokongan logistik VPA membolehkan barang bantuan bergerak melepasi titik di mana trak awam dapat beroperasi dengan selamat.
target_text: VPA logistics support allowed relief items to move beyond the point where civilian trucks could safely operate.

source_text: Laporan kerosakan MARD menyokong perancangan untuk kesihatan haiwan, penggantian benih, dan pemulihan sistem pengairan.
target_text: MARD damage reports supported planning for animal health, seed replacement, and restoration of irrigation systems.

source_text: MOT memaklumkan LCC bahawa dua jalan sekunder terbuka hanya untuk kenderaan ringan.
target_text: MOT informed the LCC that two secondary roads were open only to light vehicles.

source_text: MOH meminta sel koordinasi kesihatan bersedia menghadapi peningkatan penyakit berkaitan tempat perlindungan sepanjang minggu berikutnya.
target_text: MOH asked the health coordination cell to prepare for increased shelter-related illness over the next week.

source_text: Rakan kongsi DRRP mencadangkan latihan komuniti berdasarkan jurang yang diperhatikan dalam amaran awal dan tingkah laku pemindahan.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed community training based on gaps observed in early warning and evacuation behavior.

source_text: Aktiviti kesiapsiagaan yang disokong QPT membantu sukarelawan tempatan mengurus pemindahan awal sebelum sumber nasional tiba.
target_text: QPT-supported preparedness activities helped local volunteers manage initial evacuation before national resources arrived.

source_text: Staf cawangan VNRC membantu pengurus tempat perlindungan mengenal pasti kanak-kanak terpisah, warga emas yang dipindahkan, dan keluarga yang memerlukan bantuan khas.
target_text: VNRC branch staff helped shelter managers identify separated children, older evacuees, and families requiring special assistance.

source_text: VAMS mencadangkan penambahan penunjuk status ambulans pada papan pemuka kesihatan bersama yang digunakan oleh EOC.
target_text: VAMS recommended adding ambulance status indicators to the shared health dashboard used by the EOC.

source_text: Koordinasi WoG mengurangkan kekeliruan apabila kementerian perlu mengeluarkan arahan bersama tentang pemindahan, penutupan jalan, dan langkah kesihatan.
target_text: WoG coordination reduced confusion when ministries had to issue joint instructions on evacuation, road closures, and health precautions.

source_text: NDMO meminta rakan kongsi menjelaskan sama ada tawaran mereka merangkumi pengangkutan, bahan api, jurubahasa, dan self-sustainment.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to clarify whether their offers included transport, fuel, interpreters, and self-sustainment.

source_text: Perbincangan CMCoord membantu menukar permintaan sokongan yang luas menjadi tugas khusus untuk trak, helikopter, dan jurutera.
target_text: CMCoord discussions helped convert a broad request for support into specific tasks for trucks, helicopters, and engineers.

source_text: Saluran Mil-Mil menyahkonflik parkir dan pengisian bahan api helikopter sebelum kesesakan menjejaskan pergerakan udara kemanusiaan.
target_text: Mil-Mil channels deconflicted helicopter parking and refuelling before congestion affected humanitarian air movements.

source_text: Koordinasi Civ-Mil memastikan pergerakan konvoi tidak menghalang akses ke titik pengagihan awam.
target_text: Civ-Mil coordination ensured that convoy movements did not block access to civilian distribution points.

source_text: AS [Negara Terjejas] meminta semua pasukan antarabangsa berkongsi rancangan harian sebelum bergerak keluar dari kawasan yang ditugaskan.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] requested that all international teams share daily plans before moving outside assigned areas.

source_text: MNCC berkoordinasi dengan HOC untuk memastikan sokongan logistik ketenteraan sejajar dengan keutamaan kemanusiaan awam.
target_text: The MNCC coordinated with the HOC to ensure military logistics support aligned with civilian humanitarian priorities.

source_text: Staf EOC mengemas kini peta insiden selepas pasukan lapangan mengesahkan tiga jambatan hanya boleh digunakan oleh kenderaan kecil.
target_text: EOC staff updated the incident map after field teams confirmed three bridges were usable only for small vehicles.

source_text: RFA untuk sokongan rawatan air diutamakan selepas laporan WASH menunjukkan risiko kesihatan meningkat di tempat perlindungan.
target_text: An RFA for water treatment support was prioritized after WASH reports showed rising health risks in shelters.

source_text: COP membantu pemimpin membandingkan keperluan yang disahkan dengan aset tersedia sebelum memilih keutamaan operasi seterusnya.
target_text: The COP helped leaders compare verified needs against available assets before choosing the next operational priorities.

source_text: Operasi SAR beralih kepada pencarian sekunder selepas pihak berkuasa tempatan mengesahkan bahawa penyelamatan segera yang mengancam nyawa telah selesai.
target_text: SAR operations moved to secondary search after local authorities confirmed that immediate life-threatening rescues were complete.

source_text: Pasukan USAR berkoordinasi dengan pakar DVI apabila operasi pencarian beralih daripada penyelamatan kepada pemulihan di satu bangunan.
target_text: USAR teams coordinated with DVI specialists when search operations shifted from rescue to recovery in one building.

source_text: Unit MSAR melaraskan corak bot selepas keadaan cuaca menjadikan grid pencarian asal tidak selamat.
target_text: MSAR units adjusted boat patterns after weather conditions made the original search grid unsafe.

source_text: Bahaya CBRE diketepikan sebelum tapak gudang diluluskan untuk penyimpanan bantuan sementara.
target_text: CBRE hazards were ruled out before the warehouse site was approved for temporary relief storage.

source_text: Penjejak IOI membantu pembuat keputusan melihat isu mana yang memerlukan panduan dasar dan bukannya tindakan operasi rutin.
target_text: The IOI tracker helped decision-makers see which issues required policy guidance rather than routine operational action.

source_text: Pasukan WASH berkoordinasi dengan MOH kerana sanitasi buruk di tempat perlindungan boleh cepat menjadi masalah kesihatan awam.
target_text: WASH teams coordinated with MOH because poor sanitation in shelters could quickly become a public health problem.

source_text: Tahap stok NFI dikemas kini sebelum perancang menetapkan selimut, kit kebersihan, dan set dapur tambahan.
target_text: NFI stock levels were updated before planners committed additional blankets, hygiene kits, and kitchen sets.

source_text: HOC mengeskalasi kebimbangan komuniti tentang keadilan pengagihan yang tidak kelihatan dalam laporan logistik.
target_text: The HOC escalated community concerns about distribution equity that were not visible in logistics reports.

source_text: Perancang LCC menetapkan trak terhad berdasarkan kemendesakan kargo, akses destinasi, dan kapasiti pemunggahan.
target_text: LCC planners assigned scarce trucks based on cargo urgency, destination access, and unloading capacity.

source_text: Koordinasi AIC mencegah sorti pemetaan dron bercanggah dengan pemindahan perubatan helikopter di sepanjang laluan yang sama.
target_text: AIC coordination prevented a drone mapping sortie from conflicting with helicopter medical evacuation along the same route.

source_text: Prosedur MASCAS membimbing triage apabila latihan memperkenalkan kecederaan serentak daripada jambatan runtuh dan banjir.
target_text: MASCAS procedures guided triage when the exercise introduced simultaneous injuries from a bridge collapse and flooding.

source_text: Mutual Recognition membolehkan pasukan koordinasi mempercayai keupayaan penyelamat bersijil sambil tetap menetapkan misi secara tempatan.
target_text: Mutual Recognition allowed the coordination team to trust certified rescue capabilities while still assigning missions locally.

source_text: Pasukan penerimaan APOD memerlukan papan tanda lebih jelas supaya responden yang tiba dapat mencari kawasan pendaftaran, taklimat, dan pengangkutan dengan cepat.
target_text: The APOD reception team needed clearer signage so arriving responders could find registration, briefing, and transport areas quickly.

source_text: Kelewatan SPOD memaksa LCC mengutamakan kargo berat mana yang harus bergerak dahulu setelah berth dibuka semula.
target_text: SPOD delays forced the LCC to prioritize which heavy cargo should move first once the berth reopened.

source_text: MSR kekal rentan kerana satu bahagian curam boleh tertutup semula jika hujan melonggarkan cerun.
target_text: The MSR remained vulnerable because one steep section could close again if rain loosened the slope.

source_text: Pegawai CIQ berkoordinasi dengan NFP untuk memproses personel bantuan yang diluluskan tanpa melambatkan pasukan mendesak.
target_text: CIQ officers coordinated with the NFP to process approved relief personnel without delaying urgent teams.

source_text: Sokongan MCDA disemak berdasarkan keperluan kemanusiaan, kapasiti awam, dan kemungkinan tempoh jurang tersebut.
target_text: MCDA support was reviewed against humanitarian need, civilian capacity, and the likely duration of the gap.

source_text: Panduan HuMOCC membantu mencegah salah faham apabila perancang tentera menghadiri mesyuarat koordinasi kemanusiaan.
target_text: HuMOCC guidance helped prevent misunderstandings when military planners attended humanitarian coordination meetings.

source_text: Pasukan DVI meminta jurubahasa supaya temu bual keluarga dapat dijalankan dengan tepat dan hormat.
target_text: DVI teams requested interpreters so family interviews could be conducted accurately and respectfully.

source_text: LEMA melaporkan bahawa sukarelawan kampung telah membuka tempat perlindungan baharu yang belum disenaraikan dalam rekod nasional.
target_text: LEMA reported that village volunteers had opened a new shelter not yet listed in national records.

source_text: Pengawal Ex COORES menambah inject kekurangan bahan api untuk menguji pengutamaan logistik dan koordinasi rakan kongsi.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers added a fuel shortage inject to test logistics prioritization and partner coordination.

source_text: TTX menunjukkan bahawa peserta memerlukan proses yang lebih jelas untuk menutup permintaan yang tidak lagi relevan.
target_text: The TTX showed that participants needed a clearer process for closing requests that were no longer relevant.

source_text: OPERA CIS membantu menjejaki sama ada tawaran masih menunggu kelulusan negara tuan rumah atau sudah sedia untuk penugasan.
target_text: OPERA CIS helped track whether offers were still pending host-nation approval or ready for tasking.

source_text: Rujukan SASOP membantu pasukan menyelaraskan prosedur sokongan ASEAN dengan proses permintaan nasional affected state.
target_text: SASOP references helped the team align ASEAN support procedures with the affected state's national request process.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI dirujuk ketika membincangkan bagaimana peralatan ketenteraan harus melalui pelepasan masuk dan bergerak ke tugas yang ditetapkan.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI was cited when discussing how military equipment should clear entry and move to assigned tasks.

source_text: Prinsip AADMER menegaskan bahawa bantuan serantau harus menyokong kepimpinan nasional dan mengukuhkan kerjasama antara negara anggota.
target_text: AADMER principles reinforced that regional assistance should support national leadership and strengthen cooperation among member states.

source_text: Pengalaman ARDEX membantu pasukan latihan mereka bentuk peralihan realistik daripada operasi respons kepada perancangan pemulihan awal.
target_text: ARDEX experience helped the exercise team design realistic transitions from response operations to early recovery planning.

source_text: SME pengurusan maklumat mencadangkan sistem triage laporan yang mudah untuk tempoh bencana berjumlah laporan tinggi.
target_text: The SME on information management recommended a simple report triage system for high-volume disaster periods.

source_text: Perbincangan AAR menekankan keperluan untuk taklimat lebih pendek, pemilik tugas yang lebih jelas, dan penjejakan keputusan yang lebih baik.
target_text: AAR discussions highlighted the need for shorter briefings, clearer task owners, and better tracking of decisions.

source_text: GenAI menyokong triage terjemahan dengan mengenal pasti laporan yang memerlukan semakan manusia segera sebelum penyebaran.
target_text: GenAI supported translation triage by identifying reports that needed urgent human review before dissemination.

source_text: LLM merangka ringkasan laporan tempat perlindungan, tetapi pengurus maklumat membuang angka yang tidak pasti sebelum dikeluarkan.
target_text: The LLM drafted a summary of shelter reports, but the information manager removed uncertain numbers before release.

source_text: Data Sentinel-1 membantu perancang mengenal pasti segmen jalan yang banjir dan tersembunyi di bawah litupan awan dalam imejan optik.
target_text: Sentinel-1 data helped planners identify flooded road segments hidden beneath cloud cover in optical imagery.

source_text: Pemetaan Copernicus menyokong perbandingan laporan daerah rasmi dengan pemerhatian remote-sensing bebas.
target_text: Copernicus mapping supported the comparison of official district reports with independent remote-sensing observations.

source_text: Digital Twin menunjukkan bahawa memindahkan satu hab logistik lebih dekat ke pantai boleh memperbaik masa penghantaran.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that moving one logistics hub closer to the coast could improve delivery timing.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise membolehkan perancang jarak jauh menguji keputusan dasar sementara pasukan lapangan berlatih penerimaan kargo.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise allowed remote planners to test policy decisions while field teams practiced cargo reception.

source_text: Interoperability bertambah baik selepas pasukan maklumat menerbitkan panduan ringkas tentang nama tempat dan format data.
target_text: Interoperability improved after the information team published a short guide on place names and data formats.

source_text: Information Overload dikurangkan apabila setiap sel hanya menyerahkan keputusan yang diperlukan, perubahan besar, dan kekangan kritikal.
target_text: Information Overload was reduced when each cell submitted only decisions needed, major changes, and critical constraints.

source_text: ToR menjelaskan bahawa pegawai perhubungan harus berkongsi maklumat, bukan menugaskan aset secara bebas di luar saluran yang diluluskan.
target_text: The ToR clarified that liaison officers should share information, not independently task assets outside approved channels.

source_text: Pembangunan CONOPS merangkumi branch plans untuk penutupan pelabuhan, kesesakan lapangan terbang, lonjakan hospital, dan banjir baharu.
target_text: CONOPS development included branch plans for port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, and renewed flooding.

source_text: NFP memaklumkan rangkaian serantau bahawa dua tawaran yang diterima memerlukan masa ketibaan yang disemak semula.
target_text: The NFP informed the regional network that two accepted offers needed revised arrival times.

source_text: Sel perancangan menggunakan HADR untuk memutuskan sama ada kawasan industri yang rosak akibat banjir memerlukan nota keutamaan sektor yang seimbang.
target_text: The planning cell used HADR to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Papan pemuka Changi RHCC membantu menunjukkan keupayaan rakan kongsi mana yang boleh tiba dalam tempoh dua puluh empat jam seterusnya.
target_text: The Changi RHCC dashboard helped show which partner capabilities could arrive within the next twenty-four hours.

source_text: Sokongan pesawat US INDOPACOM dipertimbangkan hanya selepas pilihan jalan dan laut dinilai tidak mencukupi.
target_text: US INDOPACOM aircraft support was considered only after road and sea options were assessed as insufficient.

source_text: Pemerhati CFE-DM mencadangkan supaya sel koordinasi merekodkan sebab setiap pilihan operasi utama dibuat.
target_text: CFE-DM observers recommended that the coordination cell record why each major operational choice was made.

source_text: AHA Centre membantu menyelaraskan mesej sokongan serantau supaya rakan kongsi tidak menghantar maklumat bercanggah kepada affected state.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped align regional support messaging so partners did not send conflicting information to the affected state.

source_text: UN OCHA menyokong perbincangan keutamaan kemanusiaan yang memisahkan keperluan menyelamatkan nyawa segera daripada kebimbangan pemulihan awal.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a humanitarian priorities discussion that separated immediate life-saving needs from early recovery concerns.

source_text: Data penilaian ASEAN-ERAT membantu NDMO memperhalusi commune mana yang memerlukan pengesahan tambahan.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT assessment data helped the NDMO refine which communes needed additional verification.

source_text: Fasilitator ACMC membantu peserta berlatih menerangkan pilihan sokongan ketenteraan kepada pembuat keputusan awam dalam bahasa mudah.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants practice explaining military support options to civilian decision-makers in plain language.

source_text: Peta pendedahan PDC membantu mengutamakan mesej amaran untuk komuniti berhampiran sungai, cerun curam, dan jalan rosak.
target_text: PDC exposure maps helped prioritize warning messages for communities near rivers, steep slopes, and damaged roads.

source_text: WHO menasihati rakan kongsi kesihatan supaya memasukkan sokongan kesihatan mental dan psikososial dalam rancangan outreach tempat perlindungan.
target_text: WHO advised health partners to include mental health and psychosocial support in shelter outreach plans.

source_text: WFP merancang penghantaran makanan kontingensi untuk komuniti yang boleh terputus jika MSR ditutup semula.
target_text: WFP planned contingency food deliveries for communities that could be cut off if the MSR closed again.

source_text: ISCG meminta rakan kongsi mengemas kini anggaran penerima manfaat sebelum mencadangkan perluasan bantuan tempat perlindungan.
target_text: The ISCG asked partners to update beneficiary estimates before recommending an expansion of shelter assistance.

source_text: USAID BHA berkoordinasi dengan penderma lain untuk mengelakkan pembiayaan aktiviti bertindih di pusat pemindahan yang sama.
target_text: USAID BHA coordinated with other donors to avoid funding overlapping activities in the same evacuation centres.

source_text: Perbincangan ADMM-Plus menekankan interoperability praktikal antara angkatan pertahanan semasa respons bencana, bukan hanya dialog strategik.
target_text: ADMM-Plus discussions emphasized practical interoperability between defence forces during disaster response, not only strategic dialogue.

source_text: EWG on HADR mengenal pasti latihan perhubungan sebagai keperluan berulang merentasi beberapa latihan serantau.
target_text: The EWG on HADR identified liaison training as a recurring need across multiple regional exercises.

source_text: Koordinasi INSARAG membantu negara tuan rumah membahagikan kerja penyelamatan antara pasukan dengan keupayaan ringan, sederhana, dan berat.
target_text: INSARAG coordination helped the host nation divide rescue work between teams with light, medium, and heavy capabilities.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat berkongsi ringkasan mesyuarat akhir dengan negara anggota dan pemerhati latihan.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat shared the final meeting summary with member states and exercise observers.

source_text: Ahli AMRG on HADR membandingkan seberapa cepat force package berbeza boleh dikerahkan selepas permintaan rasmi.
target_text: AMRG on HADR members compared how quickly different force packages could deploy after official request.

source_text: Personel SAF memberi nasihat tentang aliran kargo yang selamat apabila forklift, bas, pasukan perubatan, dan pesawat berkongsi ruang apron terhad.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on safe cargo flow when forklifts, buses, medical teams, and aircraft shared limited apron space.

source_text: Sokongan PLA diselaraskan melalui MNCC supaya tugas kejuruteraan kekal sejajar dengan keutamaan nasional.
target_text: PLA support was coordinated through the MNCC so engineering tasks remained aligned with national priorities.

source_text: JOCCA mengekalkan matriks bantuan serantau yang menunjukkan tawaran, status penugasan, dan jurang koordinasi yang masih ada.
target_text: JOCCA maintained a regional assistance matrix that showed offers, tasking status, and remaining coordination gaps.

source_text: Pemimpin penyelamat SCDF menekankan kepentingan pengurusan keletihan semasa operasi pencarian yang berpanjangan.
target_text: SCDF rescue leaders stressed the importance of fatigue management during extended search operations.

source_text: VINASARCOM mengesahkan bahawa pihak berkuasa wilayah harus melaporkan keperluan melalui saluran nasional dan bukannya meminta pasukan asing secara langsung.
target_text: VINASARCOM confirmed that provincial authorities should report needs through national channels rather than directly requesting foreign teams.

source_text: Pemantauan sungai VDDMA menunjukkan bahawa puncak banjir akan sampai ke daerah hilir lebih lewat daripada jangkaan asal.
target_text: VDDMA river monitoring showed that flood peaks would reach downstream districts later than originally expected.

source_text: Sokongan VPA membantu membuka semula segmen jalan yang menghubungkan dua pusat pemindahan dengan hospital terdekat.
target_text: VPA support helped reopen a road segment that connected two evacuation centres with the nearest hospital.

source_text: MARD menasihati bahawa perancangan bantuan harus mengambil kira petani yang kehilangan alat, benih, dan makanan ternakan.
target_text: MARD advised that relief planning should account for farmers who lost tools, seed, and livestock feed.

source_text: Kemas kini jambatan MOT membolehkan perancang konvoi mengalihkan kargo berat ke laluan yang lebih selamat.
target_text: MOT bridge updates allowed convoy planners to shift heavy cargo onto safer routes.

source_text: MOH berkoordinasi dengan VAMS untuk membandingkan laporan kapasiti hospital dengan data pemindahan ambulans.
target_text: MOH coordinated with VAMS to compare hospital capacity reports with ambulance transfer data.

source_text: Rakan kongsi DRRP mencadangkan pengukuhan jawatankuasa bencana komuniti berdasarkan jurang yang didedahkan oleh senario.
target_text: DRRP partners recommended strengthening community disaster committees based on gaps revealed by the scenario.

source_text: Pembiayaan QPT membantu menyelenggara peralatan pemindahan tempatan yang digunakan sebelum bantuan luar tiba.
target_text: QPT funding helped maintain local evacuation equipment that was used before outside assistance arrived.

source_text: Sukarelawan VNRC mengenal pasti isi rumah yang memerlukan dokumen gantian, sokongan pencarian keluarga, dan barangan bantuan asas.
target_text: VNRC volunteers identified households needing replacement documents, family tracing support, and basic relief items.

source_text: VAMS berkongsi ringkasan lonjakan hospital sebelum mesyuarat koordinasi akhir latihan.
target_text: VAMS shared a hospital surge summary before the final coordination meeting of the exercise.

source_text: Koordinasi WoG membantu pemimpin menghubungkan keputusan kecemasan dengan perancangan pemulihan untuk pengangkutan, pertanian, dan kesihatan awam.
target_text: WoG coordination helped leaders connect emergency decisions with recovery planning for transport, agriculture, and public health.

source_text: NDMO menutup permintaan tertunda terakhir selepas mengesahkan bahawa pihak berkuasa wilayah tidak lagi memerlukan sokongan luar tambahan.
target_text: The NDMO closed the last pending request after confirming that provincial authorities no longer required additional external support.

source_text: Staf CMCoord mendokumentasikan pengajaran tentang cara meminta keupayaan ketenteraan tanpa mengganggu sistem koordinasi kemanusiaan.
target_text: CMCoord staff documented lessons on how to request military capabilities without disrupting humanitarian coordination systems.

source_text: NFP mengemas kini rakan kongsi bahawa affected state telah menerima sokongan rawatan air tetapi menolak pasukan penyelamat tambahan.
target_text: The NFP updated partners that the affected state had accepted water treatment support but declined additional rescue teams.

source_text: Semakan ringkas tentang Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] membantu operator radio mentafsir lonjakan hujan waktu malam tanpa melambatkan senarai keutamaan yang dibetulkan.
target_text: A short review of Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] helped radio operators interpret a night-time rainfall surge without delaying a corrected priority list.

source_text: 当新一轮降雨使常规任务分配决策更加复杂时，规划小组采用了HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援]。
target_text: The planning cell applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when renewed rainfall made routine tasking decisions more complicated.

source_text: 国家响应小组请求Changi RHCC [樟宜区域人道主义援助与灾害救援协调中心]协助同步即将到来的区域支援。
target_text: The national response cell asked the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] to help synchronize incoming regional support.

source_text: 在第一次协调电话会议期间，US INDOPACOM [美国印度洋-太平洋司令部]确认可提供空运方案。
target_text: During the first coordination call, US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] confirmed that airlift options were available.

source_text: 现场官员依据CFE-DM [灾害管理与人道主义援助卓越中心]的指导，完善军民协同计划。
target_text: Field officers used guidance from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] to refine the civil-military plan.

source_text: AHA Centre [东盟灾害管理人道主义援助协调中心]的更新为区级官员提供了足够细节，以便为省级仓库区制作更清晰的援助矩阵。
target_text: The update from AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] gave district officers enough detail to produce a cleaner assistance matrix for the provincial warehouse area.

source_text: 每日人道主义优先事项通过UN OCHA [联合国人道主义事务协调厅]进行协调。
target_text: Daily humanitarian priorities were aligned through UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: 对于学校避难所群，AS [受灾国]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较绕行路上方泥石流与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, AS [Affected State] gave the team a way to compare mudslides above the bypass with other response risks.

source_text: 演习控制组邀请ACMC [澳大利亚军民中心]就文职主导的协调提供建议。
target_text: The exercise control group invited ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] to advise on civilian-led coordination.

source_text: PDC [太平洋灾害中心]提供的洪水暴露图帮助规划人员识别可能需要撤离的村庄。
target_text: Flood exposure maps from PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] helped planners identify villages likely to need evacuation.

source_text: 区级官员在协调避难所报告与洪泛平原聚落通行限制时，咨询了WHO [世界卫生组织]。
target_text: District officials consulted WHO [World Health Organization] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the floodplain settlements.

source_text: 应急粮食配给通过WFP [世界粮食计划署]的后勤网络运送。
target_text: Emergency food rations were moved through WFP [World Food Programme] logistics networks.

source_text: ISCG [跨部门协调组]就相互矛盾的通行报告提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整岛屿社区的优先事项。
target_text: ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] contributed a focused update on conflicting access reports, which helped the team adjust priorities for the island communities.

source_text: 在山路绕行线，USAID BHA [美国国际开发署人道主义援助局]帮助医疗规划人员把避难人员突然增加的情况转化为更强的社区反馈闭环。
target_text: In the hill road bypass, USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] helped medical planners turn a sudden increase in shelter arrivals into a stronger community feedback loop.

source_text: 行动人员采纳ADMM-Plus [东盟防长扩大会议]的建议，以解决在不延误前沿后勤枢纽援助的情况下支援可持续多久的问题。
target_text: Operational staff used advice from ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] to resolve how long support could be sustained without delaying assistance to the forward logistics hub.

source_text: 任务分配板将EWG on HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援专家工作组]记录为山区道路走廊社区预警的关键协调联系人。
target_text: The tasking board recorded EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] as the key coordination contact for community warning in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: 响应小组在更新撤离中心网络优先事项前，将地方报告与INSARAG [国际搜索与救援咨询组]指导进行了比较。
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] before updating priorities for the evacuation centre network.

source_text: 在快速评估阶段，AS影响了各团队整理下游村庄报告的方式。
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, AS shaped how teams organized reports from the downstream villages.

source_text: AMRG on HADR [东盟军队人道主义援助与灾害救援待命组]就道路清障延误提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整临时集结基地的优先事项。
target_text: AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR] contributed a focused update on road clearance delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: 港口主管部门将SAF [新加坡武装部队]纳入讨论，因为沿海渔村需要一份平衡的部门优先事项说明。
target_text: port authorities brought SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] into the discussion because coastal fishing villages needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: 团队重新审视AS，因为相互矛盾的村庄人口数据影响了省级规划人员安排较小评估小组的方式。
target_text: The team revisited AS because conflicting village population figures affected how provincial planners planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: JOCCA [东盟联合行动协调中心]帮助将沿海地区的社区预警优先事项转达给区域联络官。
target_text: JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] helped relay community warning priorities from the coastal district to regional liaison officers.

source_text: 响应小组在更新前沿后勤枢纽优先事项前，将地方报告与SCDF [新加坡民防部队]指导进行了比较。
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] before updating priorities for the forward logistics hub.

source_text: 在快速评估阶段，AS影响了各团队整理山区道路走廊报告的方式。
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, AS shaped how teams organized reports from the mountain road corridor.

source_text: VDDMA [越南灾害与堤防管理局]就相互矛盾的通行报告提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整撤离中心网络的优先事项。
target_text: VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] contributed a focused update on conflicting access reports, which helped the team adjust priorities for the evacuation centre network.

source_text: 当绕行路上方发生泥石流时，VPA [越南人民军]与社区领导在机场货运停机坪就平衡的部门优先事项说明开展工作。
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, VPA [Vietnam People's Army] worked with community leaders on a balanced sector priority note in the airport cargo apron.

source_text: 对于下游灌溉区，AS为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较临时燃油配给与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the downstream irrigation zone, AS gave the team a way to compare a temporary fuel ration with other response risks.

source_text: MOT [交通运输部]利用区行动室更新，决定晚间车队出发前应发布哪些道路警示。
target_text: MOT [Ministry of Transport] used district operations room updates to decide which road warnings should be issued before the evening convoy.

source_text: 响应小组在更新岛屿社区优先事项前，将地方报告与MOH [卫生部]指导进行了比较。
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from MOH [Ministry of Health] before updating priorities for the island communities.

source_text: 在快速评估阶段，AS在接受额外国际支援前审查了沿海地区报告。
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, the AS reviewed coastal district reports before accepting additional international support.

source_text: QPT [自然灾害预防社区基金]就道路清障延误提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整前沿后勤枢纽的优先事项。
target_text: QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] contributed a focused update on road clearance delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the forward logistics hub.

source_text: VNRC [越南红十字会]的一份现场说明消除了洪水受损工业园区规划中的冲突，并形成了一份平衡的部门优先事项说明。
target_text: A field note from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] deconflicted planning for the flood-damaged industrial estate, leading to a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: 仓库管理人员确认西部后勤走廊情况后，AS促成了一个较小的评估小组。
target_text: AS shaped a smaller assessment team once warehouse managers confirmed conditions in the western logistics corridor.

source_text: 通信中断影响下游村庄社区后，响应时间表围绕WoG [全政府方式]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around WoG [Whole-of-Government] once telecommunications outages affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: 响应小组在更新临时集结基地优先事项前，将地方报告与NDMO [国家灾害管理办公室]指导进行了比较。
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] before updating priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: 在要求区域伙伴提供援助前，区行动室将快速评估结果发送给AS。
target_text: The district operations room sent its rapid assessment findings to the AS before regional partners were asked for assistance.

source_text: 省级仓库区报告一夜之间发生变化后，联络官将Mil-Mil [军事对军事协调]与本地语言预警信息联系起来。
target_text: liaison officers linked Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] to a local-language warning message after reports from the provincial warehouse area changed overnight.

source_text: 通信中断暴露出响应流程缺口后，协调说明引用了Civ-Mil [民事-军事协调]。
target_text: The coordination note referenced Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after telecommunications outages exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: 团队重新审视AS，因为MSR附近一处堵塞涵洞影响了捐助方代表规划较小评估小组的方式。
target_text: The team revisited AS because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how donor representatives planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: MNCC [多国协调中心]的一份现场说明消除了机场货运停机坪规划中的冲突，并促成了一次有针对性的避难所走访。
target_text: A field note from MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] deconflicted planning for the airport cargo apron, leading to a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: 救援货物积压威胁到下游灌溉区支援后，工程顾问与EOC [应急行动中心]进行了协调。
target_text: engineering advisers coordinated with EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] after a backlog of relief cargo threatened to disrupt support for the downstream irrigation zone.

source_text: 规划小组使用AS来决定港口通道是否需要更快的海关处理方案。
target_text: The planning cell used AS to decide whether the port access road needed a faster customs package.

source_text: 对于南部安置区，COP [共同作战图像]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较临时燃油配给与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, COP [Common Operating Picture] gave the team a way to compare a temporary fuel ration with other response risks.

source_text: 桥梁受损暴露出响应流程缺口后，协调说明引用了SAR [搜索与救援]。
target_text: The coordination note referenced SAR [Search and Rescue] after bridge damage exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: 在偏远公社集合点开展工作期间，USAR [城市搜索与救援]帮助区分紧急行动与常规监测。
target_text: During work on the remote commune assembly point, USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] helped separate urgent action from routine monitoring.

source_text: 通信中断影响沿海地区社区后，响应时间表围绕MSAR [海上搜索与救援]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around MSAR [Maritime Search and Rescue] once telecommunications outages affected communities in the coastal district.

source_text: 在沿海渔村，CBRE [化学、生物、放射性及爆炸影响]帮助把避难人员突然增加转化为实际的供水任务。
target_text: In coastal fishing villages, CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] helped convert a sudden increase in shelter arrivals into a practical water-supply task.

source_text: 工程顾问确认高地滑坡走廊情况后，IOI [关注事项]塑造了一项更现实的工程任务。
target_text: IOI [Issues of Interest] shaped a more realistic engineering task once engineering advisers confirmed conditions in the upland landslide corridor.

source_text: 规划小组使用WASH [水、环境卫生与个人卫生]来决定低洼集镇是否需要更简明的决策简报。
target_text: The planning cell used WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] to decide whether a low-lying market town needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: 对于学校避难所群，NFI [非食品物资]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较缺失的受益人名单与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, NFI [Non-Food Items] gave the team a way to compare a missing beneficiary list with other response risks.

source_text: 行动人员采纳HOC [人道主义行动中心]的建议，以解决在不延误临时集结基地援助的情况下支援可持续多久的问题。
target_text: Operational staff used advice from HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] to resolve how long support could be sustained without delaying assistance to the temporary staging base.

source_text: 临时桥梁地点的情况要求LCC [后勤协调中心]澄清夜间降雨激增是否改变了响应顺序。
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre] to clarify whether a night-time rainfall surge changed the response sequence.

source_text: 后勤文员请求AIC [空中整合中心]在向区指挥所投入资源前核实救护车组短缺情况。
target_text: logistics clerks asked AIC [Air Integration Centre] to verify a shortage of ambulance crews before committing resources to the district command post.

source_text: 避难人员突然增加暴露出山路绕行线规划弱点后，响应团队审查了MASCAS [大规模伤亡事件]。
target_text: The response team reviewed MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] after a sudden increase in shelter arrivals exposed a weakness in planning for the hill road bypass.

source_text: 当公共卫生团队报告道路限重不确定时，互认机制 [USAR队伍认证协议]成为制定更安全车队路线的参考依据。
target_text: When public health teams reported uncertain road weight limits, Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] became the reference point for a safer convoy route.

source_text: 对APOD [空中卸载港]的简短审查帮助评估负责人解读聚集性发热病例，同时没有延误修正后的优先事项清单。
target_text: A short review of APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] helped assessment leads interpret a cluster of fever cases without delaying a corrected priority list.

source_text: 河中岛村落报告一夜之间发生变化后，区级官员将SPOD [海上卸载港]与更小的搜索区域联系起来。
target_text: district officers linked SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to a narrower search area after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: 在北部撤离带开展工作期间，MSR [主要补给路线]帮助区分紧急行动与常规监测。
target_text: During work on the northern evacuation belt, MSR [Main Supply Route] helped separate urgent action from routine monitoring.

source_text: 当桥梁检查延误使省级仓库区规划更难预测时，民防人员采用了CIQ [海关、移民与检疫]。
target_text: civil defence staff applied CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] when a delayed bridge inspection made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: MSR附近堵塞涵洞暴露出受损渡口规划弱点后，响应团队审查了MCDA [军事与民防资产]。
target_text: The response team reviewed MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] after a blocked culvert near the MSR exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: 当联络官报告叉车能力有限时，HuMOCC [人道主义军事行动协调概念]成为修正优先事项清单的参考依据。
target_text: When liaison officers reported limited forklift availability, HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] became the reference point for a corrected priority list.

source_text: 对DVI [灾难遇难者身份识别]的简短审查帮助信息管理人员解读救援货物积压情况，同时没有延误更小搜索区域的确定。
target_text: A short review of DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] helped information managers interpret a backlog of relief cargo without delaying a narrower search area.

source_text: 绕行路上方发生泥石流后，LEMA [地方应急管理机构]帮助后勤文员围绕本地语言预警信息保持一致。
target_text: After mudslides above the bypass, LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] helped align logistics clerks around a local-language warning message.

source_text: 桥梁受损影响山区道路走廊社区后，响应时间表围绕Ex COORES [协调响应演习]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] once bridge damage affected communities in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: 团队重新审视TTX [桌面推演]，因为EOC停电影响了工程顾问规划较小评估小组的方式。
target_text: The team revisited TTX [Table-Top Exercise] because a power outage at the EOC affected how engineering advisers planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: 在洪水受损工业园区，OPERA CIS [信息共享计算机系统]帮助把桥梁检查延误转化为有针对性的避难所走访。
target_text: In the flood-damaged industrial estate, OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] helped convert a delayed bridge inspection into a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: 省级规划人员确认西部后勤走廊情况后，SASOP [区域待命安排标准作业程序]塑造了修订后的空中运输请求。
target_text: SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] shaped a revised air movement request once provincial planners confirmed conditions in the western logistics corridor.

source_text: 规划小组使用SASOP Chapter VI [军事资产便利化和使用条款]来决定沿海渔村是否需要更快的海关处理方案。
target_text: The planning cell used SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a faster customs package.

source_text: 对于高地滑坡走廊，AADMER [东盟灾害管理与应急响应协定]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较救援货物积压与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] gave the team a way to compare a backlog of relief cargo with other response risks.

source_text: 协调简报通过ARDEX [东盟区域灾害应急响应模拟演习]来呈现绕行路上方泥石流问题，使领导层能够批准较小的评估小组。
target_text: The coordination brief framed mudslides above the bypass through ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] so leaders could approve a smaller assessment team.

source_text: 团队重新审视SME [主题专家]，因为临时燃油配给影响了仓库管理人员规划有针对性避难所走访的方式。
target_text: The team revisited SME [Subject Matter Expert] because a temporary fuel ration affected how warehouse managers planned a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: 在机场货运停机坪，AAR [行动后检讨]帮助把车队折返延误转化为修订后的空中运输请求。
target_text: In the airport cargo apron, AAR [After Action Review] helped convert a convoy turnaround delay into a revised air movement request.

source_text: 捐助方代表确认下游灌溉区情况后，GenAI [生成式AI]塑造了更快的海关处理方案。
target_text: GenAI [Generative AI] shaped a faster customs package once donor representatives confirmed conditions in the downstream irrigation zone.

source_text: 规划小组使用LLM [大语言模型]来决定港口通道是否需要一份平衡的部门优先事项说明。
target_text: The planning cell used LLM [Large Language Model] to decide whether the port access road needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: 对于南部安置区，Sentinel-1 [卫星成像计划]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较受损无线电中继站与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] gave the team a way to compare a damaged radio repeater with other response risks.

source_text: 桥梁受损影响区行动室社区后，响应时间表围绕Copernicus [卫星成像计划]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the district operations room.

source_text: 团队重新审视Digital Twin [用于仿真精度的虚拟复制项目]，因为EOC停电影响了交通官员规划更现实工程任务的方式。
target_text: The team revisited Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] because a power outage at the EOC affected how transport officials planned a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: 当临时燃油配给使河中岛村落规划更难预测时，联络官采用了Hybrid Exercise [虚拟桌面推演与实地演练结合模式]。
target_text: liaison officers applied Hybrid Exercise [Model combining virtual TTX and physical FTX components] when a temporary fuel ration made planning for river-island hamlets less predictable.

source_text: 车队折返延误暴露出北部撤离带规划弱点后，响应团队审查了Interoperability [不同系统交换数据的能力]。
target_text: The response team reviewed Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] after a convoy turnaround delay exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: 当后勤文员报告相互矛盾的村庄人口数据时，Information Overload [高峰影响期管理大量数据的挑战]成为修订分发窗口的参考依据。
target_text: When logistics clerks reported conflicting village population figures, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] became the reference point for a revised distribution window.

source_text: 对ToR [职权范围]的简短审查帮助医疗规划人员解读关于受污染水井的迟报，同时没有延误分阶段放行货物。
target_text: A short review of ToR [Terms of Reference] helped medical planners interpret late reports of contaminated wells without delaying a phased cargo release.

source_text: 东部医院服务区报告一夜之间发生变化后，公共卫生团队将CONOPS [行动构想]与更好的交接说明联系起来。
target_text: public health teams linked CONOPS [Concept of Operations] to a better handover note after reports from the eastern hospital catchment changed overnight.

source_text: 临时桥梁地点的情况要求NFP [国家联络点]澄清河口附近涨潮是否改变了响应顺序。
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required NFP [National Focal Point] to clarify whether high tide near the river mouth changed the response sequence.

source_text: 地震发生后，HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援]团队先专注于救命援助，然后再转向早期恢复。
target_text: After the earthquake, HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] teams focused on life-saving assistance before shifting to early recovery.

source_text: 当多项支援提议同时到达时，区域伙伴通过Changi RHCC [樟宜区域人道主义援助与灾害救援协调中心]进行协调。
target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: 受灾政府向US INDOPACOM [美国印度洋-太平洋司令部]请求为偏远山区社区提供重型吊运支援。
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: PLA [中国人民解放军]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向北部公社前，应如何安排各方支援提议的先后顺序。
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: AHA Centre [东盟灾害管理人道主义援助协调中心]的态势更新帮助东盟伙伴协调救援优先事项。
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: 政府部委和人道主义机构参加了由UN OCHA [联合国人道主义事务协调厅]主持的协调电话会议。
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: 在受损地区，ASEAN-ERAT [东盟应急响应与评估队]在调拨额外物资前核实了避难所需求。
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: 任务分配板将ACMC [澳大利亚军民中心]记录为山区道路走廊避难所支援的关键协调联系人。
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: 河中岛村落报告一夜之间发生变化后，区级官员将ToR [职权范围]与修订后的分发窗口联系起来。
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: 卫生组请求WHO [世界卫生组织]审查疾病监测计划。
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: 地方当局与WFP [世界粮食计划署]协调，向撤离中心运送食品包。
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: 当仓库附近不安全碎片使省级仓库区规划更难预测时，后勤文员采用了ToR [职权范围]。
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: 在捐助方协调会议期间，USAID BHA [美国国际开发署人道主义援助局]审查了紧急避难补助。
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: 区域防务官员在ADMM-Plus [东盟防长扩大会议]框架下讨论了HADR准备情况。
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: EWG on HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援专家工作组]的经验教训被加入演习评估矩阵。
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: 救援队长在划分搜索区段前查阅了INSARAG [国际搜索与救援咨询组]指导。
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: 会议记录通过ASEAN Secretariat [东盟秘书处]转送，以便正式分发。
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: AMRG on HADR [东盟军队人道主义援助与灾害救援待命组]对可部署的医疗和工程单位进行了编目。
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: 水井受污染后，东道国请求SAF [新加坡武装部队]提供净水支援。
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: 来自PLA [中国人民解放军]的工程设备被分配用于恢复河流渡口通行。
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: 在响应高峰期，每日区域任务分配通过JOCCA [东盟联合行动协调中心]进行协调。
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: 在实地演练期间，SCDF [新加坡民防部队]演示了坍塌结构搜索程序。
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: 国家指挥所向VINASARCOM [越南国家民防指导委员会]报告了所有国际支援提议。
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: VDDMA [越南灾害与堤防管理局]提出的防洪优先事项影响了水泵和沙袋的分配。
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: 主要补给路线失效后，VPA [越南人民军]工程兵提供了桥梁修复支援。
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: 来自MARD [农业与农村发展部]的农业损失数据为早期恢复规划提供了依据。
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: 来自MOT [交通运输部]的道路清障更新被加入共同作战图像。
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: 直升机起飞前，MOH [卫生部]批准了医疗后送优先事项。
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: DRRP [越南减灾伙伴关系]下的恢复伙伴确定了韧性项目的优先公社。
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: 由QPT [自然灾害预防社区基金]支持的备灾信息传达到滑坡易发地区的住户。
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: VNRC [越南红十字会]的急救队在学校避难所协助老年撤离人员。
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: 来自VAMS [越南医疗服务管理局]的医院准备情况报告在晚间卫生简报中进行了共享。
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: 行动交接采用WoG [全政府方式]格式，整合了交通、卫生和防务官员关于沿海地区的更新。
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: 国际伙伴等待NDMO [国家灾害管理办公室]确认正式需求清单。
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: 当来自省会的更新相互矛盾时，CMCoord [军民协调]为规划人员提供了更清晰的优先事项比较方法。
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: 规划人员在晨间协调周期分配救援物资发放责任前，审查了Mil-Mil [军事对军事协调]。
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: 受损无线电中继站暴露出临时桥梁地点规划弱点后，响应团队审查了Civ-Mil [民事-军事协调]。
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: 当公共卫生团队报告河口附近涨潮时，AS [受灾国]成为确定更小搜索区域的参考依据。
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: 在评估负责人质疑山路绕行线报告后，MNCC [多国协调中心]提供了缺失的背景信息。
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: 区级报告在全国简报开始前送达EOC [应急行动中心]。
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: 该省提交了一份RFA [援助请求]，请求提供水处理设备和流动医疗队。
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.

source_text: 避难所入住人数在指挥官更新前被加入COP [共同作战图像]。
target_text: Shelter occupancy figures were added to the COP [Common Operating Picture] before the commanders' update.

source_text: 团队重新审视SAR [搜索与救援]，因为救护车组短缺影响了捐助方代表规划较短指挥官简报的方式。
target_text: The team revisited SAR [Search and Rescue] because a shortage of ambulance crews affected how donor representatives planned a shorter commander update.

source_text: 倒塌公寓楼需要额外的USAR [城市搜索与救援]犬只和技术搜索设备。
target_text: The collapsed apartment block required additional USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] dogs and technical search equipment.

source_text: 受损无线电中继站暴露出北部撤离带规划弱点后，响应团队审查了AS [受灾国]。
target_text: The response team reviewed AS [Affected State] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: 在清理瓦砾开始前，响应人员检查是否存在CBRE [化学、生物、放射性及爆炸影响]危害。
target_text: Before debris clearance began, responders checked whether CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] hazards were present.

source_text: 当绕行路上方发生泥石流时，PLA [中国人民解放军]与救援主管在低洼集镇就较小评估小组开展工作。
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, PLA [People's Liberation Army] worked with rescue supervisors on a smaller assessment team in a low-lying market town.

source_text: 应急厕所和清洁供水点在部门计划中被归入WASH [水、环境卫生与个人卫生]。
target_text: Emergency latrines and clean water points were grouped under WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] in the sector plan.

source_text: 毛毯、睡垫和厨房套装被登记为NFI [非食品物资]库存。
target_text: Blankets, sleeping mats, and kitchen sets were recorded as NFI [Non-Food Items] stocks.

source_text: HOC [人道主义行动中心]就桥梁受损提供了重点更新，帮助团队调整临时集结基地的优先事项。
target_text: HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] contributed a focused update on bridge damage, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: 仓库管理人员向LCC [后勤协调中心]报告了燃油和卡车短缺情况。
target_text: Warehouse managers reported fuel and truck shortages to the LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre].

source_text: 团队重新审视COP [共同作战图像]，因为MSR附近一处堵塞涵洞影响了仓库管理人员规划平衡部门优先事项说明的方式。
target_text: The team revisited COP [Common Operating Picture] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how warehouse managers planned a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: 医院演练升级为包含模拟创伤患者的MASCAS [大规模伤亡事件]情景。
target_text: The hospital drill escalated into a MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] scenario with simulated trauma patients.

source_text: 入境救援队在部署过程中受益于互认机制 [USAR队伍认证协议]。
target_text: Incoming rescue teams benefited from Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] during the deployment process.

source_text: 救援货物先通过APOD [空中卸载港]，随后由卡车运往内陆。
target_text: Relief cargo moved through the APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] before being trucked inland.

source_text: 后勤团队通过SPOD [海上卸载港]转运重型设备，以减轻机场拥堵。
target_text: The logistics team shifted heavy equipment through the SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to reduce airfield congestion.

source_text: 工程人员重新开放了连接省级仓库和撤离区域的MSR [主要补给路线]。
target_text: Engineers reopened the MSR [Main Supply Route] linking the provincial warehouse to the evacuation area.

source_text: 入境响应人员在前往集结基地前完成了CIQ [海关、移民与检疫]检查。
target_text: Incoming responders completed CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] checks before moving to the staging base.

source_text: 政府接受了MCDA [军事与民防资产]支援，用于运输、工程和医疗后送。
target_text: The government accepted MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] support for transport, engineering, and medical evacuation.

source_text: 通过将HuMOCC [人道主义军事行动协调概念]作为协调参考，人道主义优先事项得到保护。
target_text: Humanitarian priorities were protected by using HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] as the coordination reference.

source_text: 警方、法医专家和卫生人员组成了DVI [灾难遇难者身份识别]协调组。
target_text: Police, forensic specialists, and health staff formed the DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] coordination group.

source_text: 村庄领导告知LEMA [地方应急管理机构]，一个避难所的饮用水已经耗尽。
target_text: Village leaders informed LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] that one shelter had run out of drinking water.

source_text: Ex COORES [协调响应演习]参与者在现实的区域灾害情景下练习决策。
target_text: Participants in Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] practiced decision-making under a realistic regional disaster scenario.

source_text: 当道路限重不确定使省级仓库区规划更难预测时，联络官采用了TTX [桌面推演]。
target_text: liaison officers applied TTX [Table-Top Exercise] when uncertain road weight limits made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: 聚集性发热病例暴露出受损渡口规划弱点后，响应团队审查了OPERA CIS [信息共享计算机系统]。
target_text: The response team reviewed OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] after a cluster of fever cases exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: 官员在请求区域待命资产前检查了SASOP [区域待命安排标准作业程序]。
target_text: Officials checked SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] before requesting regional standby assets.

source_text: 在情景推演期间，军事资产部署依据SASOP Chapter VI [军事资产便利化和使用条款]进行了审查。
target_text: Military asset deployment was reviewed against SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] during the scenario.

source_text: 法律顾问在解释东盟灾害响应机制时引用了AADMER [东盟灾害管理与应急响应协定]。
target_text: The legal advisor cited AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] when explaining ASEAN disaster response mechanisms.

source_text: 情景设计团队为洪水响应演习改编了一个ARDEX [东盟区域灾害应急响应模拟演习]注入事件。
target_text: The scenario design team adapted an ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] inject for the flood response exercise.

source_text: 后勤SME [主题专家]警告说，港口可能在数小时内成为瓶颈。
target_text: The logistics SME [Subject Matter Expert] warned that the port could become a bottleneck within hours.

source_text: 在AAR [行动后检讨]期间，参与者指出联络官需要更清晰的交接说明。
target_text: During the AAR [After Action Review], participants noted that liaison officers needed clearer handover notes.

source_text: 使用GenAI [生成式AI]起草的报告仍需由人工行动人员审查。
target_text: Reports drafted with GenAI [Generative AI] still required review by human operational staff.

source_text: 晚间更新纳入了PLA [中国人民解放军]，因为社区反馈同时影响地方规划和区域协调。
target_text: The evening update included PLA [People's Liberation Army] because community feedback affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: 由Sentinel-1 [卫星成像计划]生成的洪水地图帮助确认哪些道路仍可通行。
target_text: Flood maps derived from Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] helped confirm which roads were still passable.

source_text: 桥梁受损影响下游村庄社区后，响应时间表围绕Copernicus [卫星成像计划]进行了调整。
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: 缺失的受益人名单暴露出偏远公社集合点规划弱点后，响应团队审查了Digital Twin [用于仿真精度的虚拟复制项目]。
target_text: The response team reviewed Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] after a missing beneficiary list exposed a weakness in planning for the remote commune assembly point.

source_text: 通信中断改变响应假设后，协调简报引用了MOT [交通运输部]的输入。
target_text: The coordination brief cited inputs from MOT [Ministry of Transport] after telecommunications outages changed the response assumptions.

source_text: 规划小组使用Interoperability [不同系统交换数据的能力]来决定沿海渔村是否需要更简明的决策简报。
target_text: The planning cell used Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: 对于高地滑坡走廊，Information Overload [高峰影响期管理大量数据的挑战]为团队提供了一种方法，用来比较救护车组短缺与其他响应风险。
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] gave the team a way to compare a shortage of ambulance crews with other response risks.

source_text: 新的联络官到达后，协调小组更新了ToR [职权范围]。
target_text: The coordination cell updated its ToR [Terms of Reference] after new liaison officers arrived.

source_text: 指挥官在向伙伴单位分配任务前介绍了CONOPS [行动构想]。
target_text: The commander briefed the CONOPS [Concept of Operations] before assigning tasks to partner units.

source_text: 每一项援助提议在接受前都通过NFP [国家联络点]转办。
target_text: Every offer of assistance was routed through the NFP [National Focal Point] before acceptance.

source_text: 当聚集性发热病例使东部医院服务区规划更难预测时，联络官采用了HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援]。
target_text: liaison officers applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when a cluster of fever cases made planning for the eastern hospital catchment less predictable.

source_text: 区级官员在协调避难所报告与受损港区通行限制时，咨询了Changi RHCC [樟宜区域人道主义援助与灾害救援协调中心]。
target_text: District officials consulted Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the damaged port area.

source_text: 在批准下一项支援包前，规划人员请求US INDOPACOM [美国印度洋-太平洋司令部]确认哪些地方的分发时间需要调整。
target_text: Before approving the next support package, planners asked US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] to confirm where distribution timing needed adjustment.

source_text: CFE-DM [灾害管理与人道主义援助卓越中心]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向洪泛平原聚落前，哪些请求已获得验证。
target_text: A liaison note from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the floodplain settlements.

source_text: 晚间更新纳入了AHA Centre [东盟灾害管理人道主义援助协调中心]，因为不确定的人口流动同时影响地方规划和区域协调。
target_text: The evening update included AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] because uncertain population movement affected both local planning and regional coordination.

source_text: 现场团队报告避难所拥挤后，UN OCHA [联合国人道主义事务协调厅]帮助细化北部公社的支援请求。
target_text: After field teams reported shelter crowding, UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs] helped refine the support request for the northern communes.

source_text: ASEAN-ERAT [东盟应急响应与评估队]加入讨论，以核实延误的救援航班是否改变了评估时间表。
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] joined the discussion to validate whether delayed relief flights had changed the assessment schedule.

source_text: 区级官员在协调避难所报告与省会通行限制时，咨询了ACMC [澳大利亚军民中心]。
target_text: District officials consulted ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the provincial capital.

source_text: 社区领导将PDC [太平洋灾害中心]纳入讨论，因为洪水受损工业园区需要一个较小的评估小组。
target_text: community leaders brought PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] into the discussion because the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a smaller assessment team.

source_text: WHO [世界卫生组织]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向受损港区前，哪些请求已获得验证。
target_text: A liaison note from WHO [World Health Organization] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the damaged port area.

source_text: 航班延误导致机场过于拥堵、无法进行常规货运后，WFP [世界粮食计划署]调整了食品配送时间表。
target_text: WFP [World Food Programme] adjusted the food delivery schedule after flight delays made the airfield too congested for routine cargo movement.

source_text: 现场团队报告社区反馈后，ISCG [跨部门协调组]帮助细化洪泛平原聚落的支援请求。
target_text: After field teams reported community feedback, ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] helped refine the support request for the floodplain settlements.

source_text: 当不确定的人口流动开始影响下一次救援行动时，规划人员将USAID BHA [美国国际开发署人道主义援助局]纳入讨论。
target_text: Planners brought USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] into the discussion once uncertain population movement began affecting the next relief movement.

source_text: 区级官员在协调避难所报告与北部公社通行限制时，咨询了ADMM-Plus [东盟防长扩大会议]。
target_text: District officials consulted ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the northern communes.

source_text: EWG on HADR [人道主义援助与灾害救援专家工作组]的更新为后勤文员提供了足够细节，以便为省级仓库区制定修订后的分发窗口。
target_text: The update from EWG on HADR [Experts Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] gave logistics clerks enough detail to produce a revised distribution window for the provincial warehouse area.

source_text: INSARAG [国际搜索与救援咨询组]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向省会前，哪些请求已获得验证。
target_text: A liaison note from INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the provincial capital.

source_text: 对于学校避难所群，工程顾问使用ASEAN Secretariat [东盟秘书处]的输入，选择了较短的指挥官简报而不是广泛响应。
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, engineering advisers used inputs from ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] to choose a shorter commander update instead of a broad response.

source_text: 现场团队报告避难所拥挤后，AMRG on HADR [东盟军队人道主义援助与灾害救援待命组]帮助细化受损港区的支援请求。
target_text: After field teams reported shelter crowding, AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR] helped refine the support request for the damaged port area.

source_text: 临时桥梁地点的情况要求SAF [新加坡武装部队]澄清聚集性发热病例是否改变了响应顺序。
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] to clarify whether a cluster of fever cases changed the response sequence.

source_text: 联络官请求PLA [中国人民解放军]在向区指挥所投入资源前核实缺失的受益人名单。
target_text: liaison officers asked PLA [People's Liberation Army] to verify a missing beneficiary list before committing resources to the district command post.

source_text: 在山路绕行线，JOCCA [东盟联合行动协调中心]帮助信息管理人员把EOC停电转化为更安全的车队路线。
target_text: In the hill road bypass, JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] helped information managers turn a power outage at the EOC into a safer convoy route.

source_text: SCDF [新加坡民防部队]的一份联络说明澄清了在伙伴支援转向北部公社前，哪些请求已获得验证。
target_text: A liaison note from SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] clarified which requests were validated before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: 当救护车组短缺出现时，VINASARCOM [越南国家民防指导委员会]与部门协调员在洪水受损工业园区就修订后的空中运输请求开展工作。
target_text: When a shortage of ambulance crews emerged, VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense] worked with sector coordinators on a revised air movement request in the flood-damaged industrial estate.

source_text: 现场团队报告社区反馈后，VDDMA [越南灾害与堤防管理局]帮助细化省会的支援请求。
target_text: After field teams reported community feedback, VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] helped refine the support request for the provincial capital.

source_text: 无线电中继站受损后，VPA [越南人民军]帮助民防人员围绕已确认的集结地点保持一致。
target_text: After a damaged radio repeater, VPA [Vietnam People's Army] helped align civil defence staff around a confirmed staging location.

source_text: 北部撤离带的情况要求MARD [农业与农村发展部]澄清河口附近涨潮是否改变了响应顺序。
target_text: The situation in the northern evacuation belt required MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] to clarify whether high tide near the river mouth changed the response sequence.

target_text: VAMS recommended clearer triggers for ambulance redistribution when several hospitals request transfers simultaneously.

target_text: WoG leaders reviewed health risks, transport restrictions, food security concerns, and engineering priorities in one meeting.

source_text: NDMO要求伙伴在每一项援助提议中列明部署时间表、持续保障需求和限制。
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to include deployment timelines, sustainment needs, and limitations in every assistance offer.

source_text: CMCoord官员在为直升机和工程单位建议任务前，将救援优先事项与军事能力进行了比较。
target_text: CMCoord officers compared relief priorities with military capabilities before recommending tasks for helicopters and engineering units.

source_text: Mil-Mil协调帮助伙伴部队在现场行动开始前消除无线电频率和集结区域冲突。
target_text: Mil-Mil coordination helped partner forces deconflict radio frequencies and staging areas before field movement began.

source_text: 当人道主义机构定期收到关于军事车队时间和路线的更新后，Civ-Mil简报得到改善。
target_text: Civ-Mil briefings improved when humanitarian agencies received predictable updates on military convoy timing and routes.

source_text: AS拒绝了未经请求的物资，因为这些物资会占用仓库空间却不能满足即时人道主义需求。
target_text: The AS declined unsolicited supplies that would have consumed warehouse space without meeting immediate humanitarian needs.

source_text: MNCC使用已核实的RFA分配外国军事支援，同时避免重复本地能力。
target_text: The MNCC used validated RFAs to assign foreign military support while avoiding duplication of local capability.

source_text: 风暴损害中断数个地区的互联网连接后，EOC工作人员转用备用通信。
target_text: EOC staff shifted to backup communications after storm damage disrupted internet connectivity in several districts.

source_text: RFA流程确保每项请求资产都针对已核实缺口，而不是笼统关切。
target_text: The RFA process ensured that every requested asset addressed a verified gap rather than a general concern.

source_text: COP显示道路状态、医院容量、避难所入住率、后勤限制和待处理的援助提议。
target_text: The COP displayed road status, hospital capacity, shelter occupancy, logistics constraints, and pending assistance offers.

source_text: 当天气条件使夜间搜索对响应人员过于危险时，SAR指挥官暂停了河上行动。
target_text: SAR commanders paused river operations when weather conditions made night search too dangerous for responders.

source_text: USAR队伍一致标记已清查区域，以便后续队伍了解剩余危险和搜索优先事项。
target_text: USAR teams marked cleared areas consistently so incoming crews could understand remaining hazards and search priorities.

source_text: MSAR协调员纳入渔业社区，因为本地知识有助于细化漂移估计和岸线搜索区域。
target_text: MSAR coordinators included fishing communities because local knowledge helped refine drift estimates and shoreline search areas.

source_text: CBRE专家在重新开放工业区附近路线前，审查了集装箱标签和排水流向。
target_text: CBRE specialists reviewed container labels and drainage patterns before reopening a route near the industrial zone.

source_text: IOI跟踪表显示，燃油可用性、直升机拥堵和避难所拥挤需要高级别决策。
target_text: The IOI tracker showed that fuel availability, helicopter congestion, and shelter crowding required senior-level decisions.

source_text: 不安全用水报告增加后，WASH伙伴优先推进氯化处理、厕所维护和卫生宣传。
target_text: WASH partners prioritized chlorination, latrine maintenance, and hygiene messaging after reports of unsafe water increased.

source_text: NFI规划考虑了家庭规模、残障需求、婴幼儿照护以及没有烹饪设备的家庭。
target_text: NFI planning accounted for household size, disability needs, infant care, and families without cooking equipment.

source_text: HOC收集了MNCC后勤和行动板上看不到的社区反馈。
target_text: The HOC collected community feedback that was not visible in the MNCC logistics and movement boards.

source_text: LCC规划人员安排货物顺序，使医疗用品、水处理物资和燃油先于较低优先级物资运输。
target_text: LCC planners sequenced cargo so medical supplies, water treatment items, and fuel moved before lower-priority materials.

source_text: AIC要求无人机团队提交飞行计划，因为直升机正在同一山谷附近运行。
target_text: The AIC required drone teams to submit flight plans because helicopters were operating near the same valley.

source_text: MASCAS程序帮助医院在演习期间协调分诊区、转运路线和患者追踪。
target_text: MASCAS procedures helped hospitals coordinate triage areas, transfer routes, and patient tracking during the exercise.

source_text: 互认机制减少了认证救援队的行政延误，同时保留东道国对任务分配的权威。
target_text: Mutual Recognition reduced administrative delays for certified rescue teams while preserving host-nation authority over tasking.

source_text: 多架救援航班携带需要机械搬运的托盘化货物抵达后，APOD需要更多叉车。
target_text: The APOD needed more forklifts after multiple relief flights arrived with palletized cargo requiring mechanical handling.

source_text: 当运载重型设备的船只抵达而商业港口作业仍受干扰时，SPOD协调变得重要。
target_text: SPOD coordination became important when vessels carrying heavy equipment arrived while commercial port operations were still disrupted.

source_text: MSR评估考虑了桥梁承载能力、滑坡暴露、燃油可用性和安全休息点。
target_text: The MSR assessment considered bridge strength, landslide exposure, fuel availability, and safe rest points.

source_text: CIQ协调帮助入境团队在无不必要延误的情况下清关通信设备、医疗物资和救援工具。
target_text: CIQ coordination helped incoming teams clear communications gear, medical supplies, and rescue tools without unnecessary delay.

source_text: MCDA规划人员每日审查支援任务，以确保军事援助仍然必要且相称。
target_text: MCDA planners reviewed support tasks daily to ensure military assistance remained necessary and proportionate.

source_text: HuMOCC概念帮助响应人员讨论联络、信息共享和任务支援，而不混淆协调与指挥。
target_text: HuMOCC concepts helped responders discuss liaison, information sharing, and task support without confusing coordination with command.

source_text: DVI程序包括家庭信息管理、证据保护、文化考量以及与地方警方协调。
target_text: DVI procedures included family information management, evidence protection, cultural considerations, and coordination with local police.

source_text: LEMA官员报告说，非正式避难所需要照明、储水和更清晰的登记支持。
target_text: LEMA officials reported that informal shelters needed lighting, water storage, and clearer registration support.

source_text: Ex COORES控制员引入突发通信中断，以测试备用报告渠道和领导层适应能力。
target_text: Ex COORES controllers introduced a sudden communications outage to test backup reporting channels and leadership adaptability.

source_text: TTX显示，当多个部门请求稀缺运输资产时，决策简报需要更清晰的选项。
target_text: The TTX revealed that decision briefs needed clearer options when multiple sectors requested scarce transport assets.

source_text: OPERA CIS条目在每次会议前更新，以免领导层依据过时请求采取行动。
target_text: OPERA CIS entries were updated before each meeting so leaders would not act on outdated requests.

source_text: SASOP启动步骤指导了从国家请求到东盟区域协调的流程顺序。
target_text: SASOP activation steps guided the sequence from national request through ASEAN regional coordination.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI帮助参与者讨论军事资产的海关、机动和便利化要求。
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped participants discuss customs, movement, and facilitation requirements for military assets.

source_text: AADMER承诺支持东盟灾害管理主管部门之间及时共享信息与合作。
target_text: AADMER commitments supported timely information sharing and cooperation among ASEAN disaster management authorities.

source_text: ARDEX经验塑造了媒体关注、后勤延误和部门优先事项竞争等压力点。
target_text: ARDEX lessons shaped the pressure points involving media attention, logistics delays, and competing sector priorities.

source_text: 卫生行动SME建议将疾病监测直接连接到转诊和隔离程序。
target_text: The SME on health operations recommended linking disease surveillance directly to referral and isolation procedures.

source_text: AAR引导员要求每个小组确定一项流程改进和一项值得保留的做法。
target_text: AAR facilitators asked each cell to identify one process improvement and one practice worth keeping.

source_text: GenAI根据长篇报告生成简报草稿，但工作人员删除了缺乏依据或含糊不清的表述。
target_text: GenAI produced draft briefing notes from long reports, but staff removed unsupported or ambiguous statements.

source_text: LLM帮助比较多语言更新，使信息团队能够避免误译行动类别。
target_text: The LLM helped compare multilingual updates so the information team could avoid mistranslating operational categories.

source_text: Sentinel-1产品让规划人员确信，尽管地面通行受限，北部路线仍处于洪水淹没状态。
target_text: Sentinel-1 products gave planners confidence that the northern route remained flooded despite limited ground access.

source_text: Copernicus图层被加入COP，以引导现场核实团队前往受灾最严重的聚落。
target_text: Copernicus layers were added to the COP to guide field verification teams toward the hardest-hit settlements.

source_text: Digital Twin显示，临时桥梁比额外空中支援更能缩短救护车通行时间。
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that a temporary bridge could reduce ambulance travel time more than additional air support.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise规划要求将远程政策注入事件与模拟APOD的现场活动进行时间衔接。
target_text: Hybrid Exercise planning required timing remote policy injects with field activities at the simulated APOD.

source_text: 当伙伴使用不同坐标格式和同一村庄的非正式名称时，Interoperability挑战显现出来。
target_text: Interoperability challenges appeared when partners used different coordinate formats and informal names for the same villages.

source_text: 余震注入事件期间，Information Overload再次出现，直到报告通过信息管理台进行筛选。
target_text: Information Overload returned during the aftershock inject until reports were filtered through the information management desk.

source_text: ToR要求联络官提交简明更新、识别阻碍因素，并标明需要领导层决策的事项。
target_text: The ToR required liaison officers to submit concise updates, identify blockers, and flag decisions needed from leaders.

source_text: CONOPS批准取决于关于天气窗口、港口通行、安全条件和救援优先事项的假设。
target_text: CONOPS approval depended on assumptions about weather windows, port access, security conditions, and relief priorities.

source_text: NFP通知伙伴，医疗队已被接受，但额外捐赠衣物被拒绝。
