target_text: As the AS [Affected State], the government confirmed that all incoming teams would operate under national disaster management priorities.

source_text: MNCC theo dõi yêu cầu hỗ trợ quân sự nước ngoài từ phê duyệt đến hoàn tất để không máy bay hoặc đội kỹ thuật nào bị giao nhiệm vụ trùng.
target_text: The MNCC tracked foreign military support requests from approval through completion so no aircraft or engineering team was double-tasked.

source_text: Quản lý EOC sử dụng cập nhật cấp huyện để quyết định liệu hỗ trợ sơ tán hay tiếp tế bệnh viện cần được nâng cấp ngay lập tức.
target_text: EOC managers used district updates to decide whether evacuation support or hospital resupply needed immediate escalation.

source_text: RFA cho vận tải đường không mô tả loại hàng, số hành khách, điểm bốc hàng, điểm đến và mức độ nhạy cảm thời gian.
target_text: The RFA for airlift described cargo type, passenger numbers, loading point, destination, and time sensitivity.

source_text: COP bao gồm mức độ tin cậy cho bản đồ lũ, báo cáo đường bộ, số liệu nơi trú ẩn và ước tính năng lực bệnh viện.
target_text: The COP included confidence levels for flood maps, road reports, shelter figures, and hospital capacity estimates.

source_text: Các đội SAR phối hợp với lãnh đạo làng để xác định nhà có người dân có thể đã phớt lờ lệnh sơ tán.
target_text: SAR teams coordinated with village leaders to identify homes where residents might have ignored evacuation orders.

source_text: Các đội USAR yêu cầu thông tin kết cấu cập nhật trước khi vào tòa nhà văn phòng bị hư hỏng gần bờ sông.
target_text: USAR crews requested updated structural information before entering the damaged office block near the riverfront.

source_text: Các nhà lập kế hoạch MSAR điều chỉnh khu vực tìm kiếm sau khi dữ liệu gió và thủy triều làm thay đổi ước tính trôi dạt qua đêm.
target_text: MSAR planners adjusted the search area after wind and tide data changed overnight drift estimates.

source_text: Lực lượng ứng phó CBRE thiết lập vành đai an toàn quanh nhà kho cho đến khi có kết quả quan trắc không khí.
target_text: CBRE responders established a safety perimeter around the warehouse until air monitoring results were available.

source_text: Bảng IOI liệt kê các quyết định chưa giải quyết về trình tự chuyến bay cứu trợ, chậm trễ hải quan, chen chúc nơi trú ẩn và thông điệp công cộng.
target_text: The IOI board listed unresolved decisions on relief flight sequencing, customs delays, shelter crowding, and public messaging.

source_text: Các đối tác WASH ưu tiên lưu trữ nước an toàn vì một số gia đình đang tái sử dụng vật chứa bị ô nhiễm trong trung tâm sơ tán.
target_text: WASH partners prioritized safe water storage because some families were reusing contaminated containers in evacuation centres.

source_text: Nhân viên hậu cần nối NFI với một ghi chú bàn giao tốt hơn sau khi báo cáo từ các xóm trên đảo sông thay đổi qua đêm.
target_text: logistics clerks linked NFI to a better handover note after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: HOC thu thập các quan ngại bảo vệ từ đối tác nhân đạo trước khi báo cáo cho thành phần điều phối quân sự.
target_text: The HOC gathered protection concerns from humanitarian partners before briefing the military coordination element.

source_text: Sĩ quan LCC so sánh năng lực đoàn xe với yêu cầu hàng khẩn cấp trước khi cho xe tải di chuyển tới trung tâm tiền phương.
target_text: LCC officers compared convoy capacity with urgent cargo requests before releasing trucks to the forward hub.

source_text: AIC trì hoãn một nhiệm vụ khảo sát bằng máy bay không người lái cho đến khi trực thăng sơ tán y tế rời khỏi hành lang bay gần đó.
target_text: The AIC delayed a survey drone mission until medical evacuation helicopters cleared the nearby air corridor.

source_text: Các tình huống MASCAS kiểm tra liệu điều phối viên xe cứu thương có thể định tuyến bệnh nhân khi hai bệnh viện đạt công suất cùng lúc hay không.
target_text: MASCAS injects tested whether ambulance dispatchers could route patients when two hospitals reached capacity simultaneously.

source_text: Mutual Recognition giúp quốc gia chủ nhà tích hợp các đội cứu hộ được chứng nhận mà không lặp lại rà soát năng lực đầy đủ.
target_text: Mutual Recognition helped the host nation integrate certified rescue teams without repeating full qualification reviews.

source_text: Đội APOD tạo các làn riêng cho tiếp nhận nhân sự, xử lý hàng hóa và phân công vận chuyển tiếp.
target_text: The APOD team created separate lanes for personnel reception, cargo handling, and onward transport assignment.

source_text: Quản lý SPOD lên lịch dỡ thiết bị nặng vào ban đêm để giảm ảnh hưởng đến di chuyển hàng cứu trợ ban ngày.
target_text: SPOD managers scheduled heavy equipment offload at night to reduce interference with daytime relief cargo movement.

source_text: MSR mở lại sau khi kỹ sư lắp thoát nước tạm thời và dọn bùn khỏi đoạn dốc nhất.
target_text: The MSR reopened after engineers installed temporary drainage and cleared mud from the steepest section.

source_text: Xử lý CIQ được cải thiện khi các đội đến gửi danh sách thiết bị, vật tư y tế và chi tiết hộ chiếu trước khi khởi hành.
target_text: CIQ processing improved when incoming teams submitted equipment lists, medical supplies, and passport details before departure.

source_text: Yêu cầu MCDA được giới hạn ở các khoảng trống nhạy cảm thời gian mà lực lượng ứng phó dân sự không thể xử lý bằng nguồn lực sẵn có.
target_text: MCDA requests were limited to time-sensitive gaps that civilian responders could not address with available resources.

source_text: Nguyên tắc HuMOCC cung cấp cho bộ phận điều phối một ngôn ngữ trung lập để thảo luận hỗ trợ quân sự cho các nhiệm vụ nhân đạo.
target_text: HuMOCC principles gave the coordination cell a neutral language for discussing military support to humanitarian tasks.

source_text: Nhân sự DVI làm việc với chính quyền địa phương để ghi nhận thông tin người mất tích và quản lý thủ tục nhận dạng một cách tôn trọng.
target_text: DVI personnel worked with local authorities to record missing-person information and manage identification procedures respectfully.

source_text: LEMA thông báo cho các nhà lập kế hoạch quốc gia rằng một trung tâm sơ tán được liệt kê không có nguồn nước và không nên tiếp nhận thêm gia đình.
target_text: LEMA informed national planners that one listed evacuation centre had no water supply and should not receive more families.

source_text: Đánh giá viên Ex COORES quan sát người tham gia nhận ra các đề nghị trùng lặp nhanh đến đâu và chuyển hướng hỗ trợ sang nhu cầu chưa được đáp ứng.
target_text: Ex COORES evaluators observed how quickly participants recognized duplicated offers and redirected support to unmet needs.

source_text: TTX thách thức quan chức ưu tiên giữa vận tải đường không cho vật tư y tế và hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho một cây cầu bị hư hỏng.
target_text: The TTX challenged officials to prioritize between airlift for medical supplies and engineering support for a damaged bridge.

source_text: Các mục OPERA CIS giúp nhóm thông tin thấy những yêu cầu nào cần làm rõ trước khi có thể giao nhiệm vụ.
target_text: OPERA CIS entries helped the information team see which requests needed clarification before they could be tasked.

source_text: Hướng dẫn SASOP hỗ trợ thảo luận về cách các sắp xếp dự phòng ASEAN nên được yêu cầu, tạo thuận lợi và báo cáo.
target_text: SASOP guidance supported the discussion on how ASEAN standby arrangements should be requested, facilitated, and reported.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI giúp cố vấn pháp lý giải thích yêu cầu tiếp nhận và điều phối tài sản quân sự nước ngoài.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI helped legal advisers explain requirements for receiving and coordinating foreign military assets.

source_text: AADMER được sử dụng làm tham chiếu chính sách cho hợp tác khu vực, hỗ trợ lẫn nhau và chia sẻ thông tin.
target_text: AADMER was used as the policy reference for regional cooperation, mutual assistance, and information sharing.

source_text: Bài học ARDEX ảnh hưởng đến quyết định đưa vào đồng thời các tình huống gián đoạn cảng, lũ lụt và y tế công cộng.
target_text: ARDEX lessons influenced the decision to include simultaneous port disruption, flooding, and public health injects.

source_text: SME khuyến nghị các kịch bản tương lai đưa thêm áp lực lên quản lý thông tin trong giai đoạn báo cáo cao điểm.
target_text: The SME recommended that future scenarios include more pressure on information managers during peak reporting periods.

source_text: AAR xác định khoảng trống trong bàn giao ca liên lạc, thủ tục đóng nhiệm vụ và chất lượng tóm tắt ngành.
target_text: The AAR identified gaps in liaison shift handovers, task closure procedures, and the quality of sector summaries.

source_text: GenAI tạo bản nháp đầu tiên của tóm tắt tình hình, nhưng các nhà phân tích kiểm tra từng dòng với báo cáo đã xác minh.
target_text: GenAI produced a first draft of the situation summary, but analysts checked every line against verified reports.

source_text: LLM giúp chuyển ghi chú đánh giá kỹ thuật thành cập nhật ngôn ngữ đơn giản cho buổi báo cáo điều phối.
target_text: The LLM helped convert technical assessment notes into plain-language updates for the coordination briefing.

source_text: Ảnh radar Sentinel-1 hỗ trợ lập bản đồ lũ khi tuần tra mặt đất không thể đến lưu vực sông phía bắc.
target_text: Sentinel-1 radar imagery supported flood mapping when ground patrols could not reach the northern river basin.

source_text: Sản phẩm Copernicus giúp so sánh các khu dân cư bị ảnh hưởng, đường hư hỏng và hạn chế tiếp cận có khả năng xảy ra trên toàn tỉnh.
target_text: Copernicus products helped compare affected settlements, damaged roads, and likely access constraints across the province.

source_text: Digital Twin cho phép các nhà lập kế hoạch kiểm tra liệu di chuyển khu tập kết có rút ngắn thời gian giao hàng hay không.
target_text: The Digital Twin allowed planners to test whether moving the staging area would shorten delivery times.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise kết hợp giải quyết vấn đề cấp chính sách với nhiệm vụ tiếp nhận cấp hiện trường tại sân bay mô phỏng.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise combined policy-level problem solving with field-level reception tasks at the simulated airport.

source_text: Vấn đề Interoperability giảm sau khi tất cả các đội sử dụng cùng tiêu đề bảng tính và mã định danh huyện.
target_text: Interoperability problems decreased once all teams used the same spreadsheet headings and district identifiers.

source_text: Information Overload tăng khi ảnh chưa lọc, ghi chú thô và báo cáo trùng lặp đến nhóm báo cáo cấp cao.
target_text: Information Overload increased when unfiltered photographs, raw notes, and duplicate reports reached the senior briefing team.

source_text: ToR yêu cầu mỗi trưởng bộ phận cung cấp cập nhật ngắn gọn và xác định các quyết định cần lãnh đạo chú ý.
target_text: The ToR required each cell lead to provide concise updates and identify decisions that needed leadership attention.

source_text: Các giả định CONOPS được sửa đổi sau khi dự báo thời tiết mới rút ngắn cửa sổ sẵn có cho hoạt động trực thăng.
target_text: CONOPS assumptions were revised after new weather forecasts shortened the available window for helicopter operations.

source_text: NFP chỉ ghi nhận các đề nghị mới sau khi xác nhận liệu chúng có khớp danh sách nhu cầu đã xác thực mới nhất hay không.
target_text: The NFP acknowledged new offers only after confirming whether they matched the latest validated needs list.

source_text: Các đội HADR chuyển từ ứng phó nhanh sang ổn định sau khi hoạt động cứu hộ kết thúc và dịch vụ nơi trú ẩn trở thành ưu tiên chính.
target_text: HADR teams shifted from rapid response to stabilization once rescue operations ended and shelter services became the main priority.

source_text: Changi RHCC giúp duy trì nhận thức tình hình khu vực bằng cách so sánh năng lực đối tác với các RFA đã được chấp nhận.
target_text: The Changi RHCC helped maintain regional situational awareness by comparing partner capabilities with accepted RFAs.

source_text: Các nhà lập kế hoạch US INDOPACOM chia sẻ giới hạn máy bay để MNCC tránh giao các nhiệm vụ hàng hóa không phù hợp.
target_text: US INDOPACOM planners shared aircraft constraints so the MNCC could avoid assigning unsuitable cargo missions.

source_text: Tài liệu CFE-DM hỗ trợ thảo luận về lý do kỷ luật thông tin quan trọng trong các hoạt động đa quốc gia chuyển biến nhanh.
target_text: CFE-DM materials supported a discussion on why information discipline matters during fast-moving multinational operations.

source_text: AHA Centre phối hợp với NDMO để cập nhật cho các đối tác ASEAN về khoảng trống hậu cần và ưu tiên nơi trú ẩn.
target_text: The AHA Centre coordinated with the NDMO to update ASEAN partners on logistics gaps and shelter priorities.

source_text: UN OCHA giúp các đối tác chuẩn bị thông điệp chung về tiếp cận nhân đạo và hỗ trợ vô tư.
target_text: UN OCHA helped partners prepare a joint message on humanitarian access and impartial assistance.

source_text: Phát hiện của ASEAN-ERAT cho thấy một số làng cần tiếp cận y tế khẩn cấp hơn so với lương thực bổ sung.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT findings showed that some villages needed medical outreach more urgently than additional food supplies.

source_text: Cố vấn ACMC khuyến khích các nhà lập kế hoạch ghi lại giả định mỗi khi tài sản quân sự được dùng cho nhiệm vụ cứu trợ dân sự.
target_text: ACMC advisers encouraged planners to document assumptions whenever military assets were used for civilian relief tasks.

source_text: Mô hình PDC nêu bật một huyện đối mặt cả phơi nhiễm lũ và thiếu phương án thay thế tuyến sơ tán.
target_text: PDC modelling highlighted that one district faced both flood exposure and limited evacuation-route redundancy.

source_text: WHO khuyến nghị các đội y tế lập bản đồ phương án chuyển tuyến cho lọc máu, chăm sóc thai sản và điều trị chấn thương.
target_text: WHO recommended that health teams map referral options for dialysis, maternity care, and trauma treatment.

source_text: WFP phối hợp với nhà vận tải địa phương sau khi năng lực xe tải thương mại trở thành hạn chế tác nghiệp lớn.
target_text: WFP coordinated with local transport providers after commercial trucking capacity became a major operational constraint.

source_text: ISCG hợp nhất nhu cầu ngành để nhà tài trợ có thể so sánh khoảng trống khẩn cấp mà không phải đọc các báo cáo kỹ thuật riêng.
target_text: The ISCG consolidated sector needs so donors could compare urgent gaps without reading separate technical reports.

source_text: USAID BHA rà soát liệu các hoạt động đề xuất có bao gồm điều phối với chính quyền địa phương và mốc thời gian giao hàng thực tế hay không.
target_text: USAID BHA reviewed whether proposed activities included coordination with local authorities and realistic delivery timelines.

source_text: Quan sát viên ADMM-Plus lưu ý rằng thủ tục chung cải thiện lòng tin trước khi áp lực tác nghiệp tăng lên trong kịch bản.
target_text: ADMM-Plus observers noted that common procedures improved trust before operational pressure increased during the scenario.

source_text: EWG on HADR khuyến nghị diễn tập thường xuyên hơn về điều phối hậu cần đa quốc gia trong các cuộc diễn tập khu vực.
target_text: The EWG on HADR recommended more frequent rehearsal of multinational logistics coordination during regional exercises.

source_text: Quản lý hiện trường INSARAG giảm nhầm lẫn khi nhiều đội cứu hộ đến cùng một công trình sập.
target_text: INSARAG worksite management reduced confusion when multiple rescue teams arrived at the same collapsed structure.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat lưu giữ hồ sơ quyết định chính thức để theo dõi trong các cuộc họp HADR khu vực tương lai.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat preserved the official record of decisions for follow-up during future regional HADR meetings.

source_text: Người tham gia AMRG on HADR xem xét liệu các đơn vị có thể triển khai có đủ tự duy trì cho hoạt động vùng xa hay không.
target_text: AMRG on HADR participants examined whether deployable units had enough self-sustainment for remote operations.

source_text: Các đội SAF chia sẻ kinh nghiệm tích hợp lập kế hoạch sơ tán y tế với thủ tục tiếp nhận sân bay.
target_text: SAF teams shared experience on integrating medical evacuation planning with airfield reception procedures.

source_text: Kỹ sư PLA yêu cầu dữ liệu khảo sát địa phương trước khi cam kết thiết bị cho điểm vượt sông bị hư hỏng.
target_text: PLA engineers requested local survey data before committing equipment to the damaged river crossing.

source_text: JOCCA giúp xác định khi nào một đề nghị khu vực nên được chuyển hướng vì nhu cầu ban đầu đã được đáp ứng.
target_text: JOCCA helped identify when a regional offer should be redirected because the original need had already been met.

source_text: Giảng viên SCDF rà soát giao thức liên lạc cứu hộ kỹ thuật với các đội địa phương trước cuộc diễn tập ban đêm.
target_text: SCDF instructors reviewed technical rescue communication protocols with local teams before the night exercise.

source_text: VINASARCOM điều phối phê duyệt quốc gia để đối tác quốc tế không đàm phán riêng với nhiều tỉnh.
target_text: VINASARCOM coordinated national approvals so international partners would not negotiate separately with multiple provinces.

source_text: Cập nhật của VDDMA giúp các nhà lập kế hoạch sơ tán dự đoán những vùng thấp nào có thể ngập lại sau xả đập.
target_text: VDDMA updates helped evacuation planners anticipate which low-lying areas could flood again after dam releases.

source_text: Hỗ trợ hậu cần VPA cho phép hàng cứu trợ di chuyển vượt qua điểm mà xe tải dân sự không thể hoạt động an toàn.
target_text: VPA logistics support allowed relief items to move beyond the point where civilian trucks could safely operate.

source_text: Báo cáo thiệt hại MARD hỗ trợ lập kế hoạch cho sức khỏe vật nuôi, thay thế giống và khôi phục hệ thống tưới tiêu.
target_text: MARD damage reports supported planning for animal health, seed replacement, and restoration of irrigation systems.

source_text: MOT thông báo cho LCC rằng hai đường phụ chỉ mở cho xe nhẹ.
target_text: MOT informed the LCC that two secondary roads were open only to light vehicles.

source_text: MOH đề nghị bộ phận điều phối y tế chuẩn bị cho bệnh liên quan đến nơi trú ẩn gia tăng trong tuần tới.
target_text: MOH asked the health coordination cell to prepare for increased shelter-related illness over the next week.

source_text: Các đối tác DRRP đề xuất đào tạo cộng đồng dựa trên khoảng trống quan sát được trong cảnh báo sớm và hành vi sơ tán.
target_text: DRRP partners proposed community training based on gaps observed in early warning and evacuation behavior.

source_text: Hoạt động chuẩn bị sẵn sàng do QPT hỗ trợ giúp tình nguyện viên địa phương quản lý sơ tán ban đầu trước khi nguồn lực quốc gia đến.
target_text: QPT-supported preparedness activities helped local volunteers manage initial evacuation before national resources arrived.

source_text: Nhân viên chi nhánh VNRC giúp quản lý nơi trú ẩn xác định trẻ em bị chia tách, người sơ tán cao tuổi và gia đình cần hỗ trợ đặc biệt.
target_text: VNRC branch staff helped shelter managers identify separated children, older evacuees, and families requiring special assistance.

source_text: VAMS khuyến nghị thêm chỉ báo tình trạng xe cứu thương vào bảng điều khiển y tế chung được EOC sử dụng.
target_text: VAMS recommended adding ambulance status indicators to the shared health dashboard used by the EOC.

source_text: Điều phối WoG giảm nhầm lẫn khi các bộ phải ban hành chỉ dẫn chung về sơ tán, đóng đường và biện pháp phòng ngừa y tế.
target_text: WoG coordination reduced confusion when ministries had to issue joint instructions on evacuation, road closures, and health precautions.

source_text: NDMO đề nghị các đối tác làm rõ liệu đề nghị của họ có bao gồm vận tải, nhiên liệu, phiên dịch viên và khả năng tự duy trì hay không.
target_text: The NDMO asked partners to clarify whether their offers included transport, fuel, interpreters, and self-sustainment.

source_text: Thảo luận CMCoord giúp chuyển một yêu cầu hỗ trợ rộng thành các nhiệm vụ cụ thể cho xe tải, trực thăng và kỹ sư.
target_text: CMCoord discussions helped convert a broad request for support into specific tasks for trucks, helicopters, and engineers.

source_text: Các kênh Mil-Mil gỡ xung đột bãi đỗ trực thăng và tiếp nhiên liệu trước khi ùn tắc ảnh hưởng đến di chuyển hàng không nhân đạo.
target_text: Mil-Mil channels deconflicted helicopter parking and refuelling before congestion affected humanitarian air movements.

source_text: Điều phối Civ-Mil bảo đảm di chuyển đoàn xe không chặn tiếp cận tới các điểm phân phối dân sự.
target_text: Civ-Mil coordination ensured that convoy movements did not block access to civilian distribution points.

source_text: AS [Affected State] yêu cầu tất cả các đội quốc tế chia sẻ kế hoạch hằng ngày trước khi di chuyển ra ngoài khu vực được giao.
target_text: The AS [Affected State] requested that all international teams share daily plans before moving outside assigned areas.

source_text: MNCC phối hợp với HOC để bảo đảm hỗ trợ hậu cần quân sự phù hợp với các ưu tiên nhân đạo dân sự.
target_text: The MNCC coordinated with the HOC to ensure military logistics support aligned with civilian humanitarian priorities.

source_text: Nhân viên EOC cập nhật bản đồ sự cố sau khi các nhóm hiện trường xác nhận ba cây cầu chỉ dùng được cho xe nhỏ.
target_text: EOC staff updated the incident map after field teams confirmed three bridges were usable only for small vehicles.

source_text: Một RFA cho hỗ trợ xử lý nước được ưu tiên sau khi báo cáo WASH cho thấy rủi ro y tế gia tăng trong nơi trú ẩn.
target_text: An RFA for water treatment support was prioritized after WASH reports showed rising health risks in shelters.

source_text: COP giúp lãnh đạo so sánh nhu cầu đã xác minh với tài sản sẵn có trước khi chọn ưu tiên tác nghiệp tiếp theo.
target_text: The COP helped leaders compare verified needs against available assets before choosing the next operational priorities.

source_text: Hoạt động SAR chuyển sang tìm kiếm thứ cấp sau khi chính quyền địa phương xác nhận các ca cứu hộ đe dọa tính mạng tức thời đã hoàn tất.
target_text: SAR operations moved to secondary search after local authorities confirmed that immediate life-threatening rescues were complete.

source_text: Các đội USAR phối hợp với chuyên gia DVI khi hoạt động tìm kiếm chuyển từ cứu hộ sang thu hồi trong một tòa nhà.
target_text: USAR teams coordinated with DVI specialists when search operations shifted from rescue to recovery in one building.

source_text: Các đơn vị MSAR điều chỉnh mô hình thuyền sau khi điều kiện thời tiết khiến lưới tìm kiếm ban đầu không an toàn.
target_text: MSAR units adjusted boat patterns after weather conditions made the original search grid unsafe.

source_text: Các nguy cơ CBRE được loại trừ trước khi khu nhà kho được phê duyệt làm nơi lưu trữ cứu trợ tạm thời.
target_text: CBRE hazards were ruled out before the warehouse site was approved for temporary relief storage.

source_text: Bảng theo dõi IOI giúp người ra quyết định thấy vấn đề nào cần hướng dẫn chính sách thay vì hành động tác nghiệp thường lệ.
target_text: The IOI tracker helped decision-makers see which issues required policy guidance rather than routine operational action.

source_text: Các đội WASH phối hợp với MOH vì vệ sinh kém trong nơi trú ẩn có thể nhanh chóng trở thành vấn đề y tế công cộng.
target_text: WASH teams coordinated with MOH because poor sanitation in shelters could quickly become a public health problem.

source_text: Mức tồn kho NFI được cập nhật trước khi các nhà lập kế hoạch cam kết thêm chăn, bộ vệ sinh và bộ dụng cụ nhà bếp.
target_text: NFI stock levels were updated before planners committed additional blankets, hygiene kits, and kitchen sets.

source_text: HOC nâng cấp các quan ngại cộng đồng về công bằng phân phối vốn không hiện rõ trong báo cáo hậu cần.
target_text: The HOC escalated community concerns about distribution equity that were not visible in logistics reports.

source_text: Các nhà lập kế hoạch LCC phân bổ xe tải khan hiếm dựa trên mức khẩn cấp của hàng, khả năng tiếp cận điểm đến và năng lực dỡ hàng.
target_text: LCC planners assigned scarce trucks based on cargo urgency, destination access, and unloading capacity.

source_text: Điều phối AIC ngăn một chuyến bay lập bản đồ bằng máy bay không người lái xung đột với sơ tán y tế bằng trực thăng trên cùng tuyến.
target_text: AIC coordination prevented a drone mapping sortie from conflicting with helicopter medical evacuation along the same route.

source_text: Thủ tục MASCAS hướng dẫn phân loại khi diễn tập đưa vào các ca thương tích đồng thời từ sập cầu và lũ lụt.
target_text: MASCAS procedures guided triage when the exercise introduced simultaneous injuries from a bridge collapse and flooding.

source_text: Mutual Recognition cho phép nhóm điều phối tin tưởng năng lực cứu hộ được chứng nhận trong khi vẫn giao nhiệm vụ tại địa phương.
target_text: Mutual Recognition allowed the coordination team to trust certified rescue capabilities while still assigning missions locally.

source_text: Đội tiếp nhận APOD cần biển chỉ dẫn rõ hơn để lực lượng ứng phó đến nơi nhanh chóng tìm được khu đăng ký, báo cáo và vận chuyển.
target_text: The APOD reception team needed clearer signage so arriving responders could find registration, briefing, and transport areas quickly.

source_text: Chậm trễ SPOD buộc LCC ưu tiên hàng nặng nào nên di chuyển trước khi cầu cảng mở lại.
target_text: SPOD delays forced the LCC to prioritize which heavy cargo should move first once the berth reopened.

source_text: MSR vẫn dễ bị tổn thương vì một đoạn dốc có thể lại bị đóng nếu mưa làm sườn dốc lỏng ra.
target_text: The MSR remained vulnerable because one steep section could close again if rain loosened the slope.

source_text: Sĩ quan CIQ phối hợp với NFP để xử lý nhân sự cứu trợ đã được phê duyệt mà không làm chậm các đội khẩn cấp.
target_text: CIQ officers coordinated with the NFP to process approved relief personnel without delaying urgent teams.

source_text: Hỗ trợ MCDA được rà soát theo nhu cầu nhân đạo, năng lực dân sự và thời gian có thể kéo dài của khoảng trống.
target_text: MCDA support was reviewed against humanitarian need, civilian capacity, and the likely duration of the gap.

source_text: Hướng dẫn HuMOCC giúp ngăn hiểu lầm khi các nhà lập kế hoạch quân sự tham dự cuộc họp điều phối nhân đạo.
target_text: HuMOCC guidance helped prevent misunderstandings when military planners attended humanitarian coordination meetings.

source_text: Các đội DVI yêu cầu phiên dịch viên để phỏng vấn gia đình được thực hiện chính xác và tôn trọng.
target_text: DVI teams requested interpreters so family interviews could be conducted accurately and respectfully.

source_text: LEMA báo cáo rằng tình nguyện viên làng đã mở một nơi trú ẩn mới chưa được liệt kê trong hồ sơ quốc gia.
target_text: LEMA reported that village volunteers had opened a new shelter not yet listed in national records.

source_text: Điều hành viên Ex COORES thêm tình huống thiếu nhiên liệu để kiểm tra ưu tiên hậu cần và điều phối đối tác.
target_text: Ex COORES controllers added a fuel shortage inject to test logistics prioritization and partner coordination.

source_text: TTX cho thấy người tham gia cần quy trình rõ hơn để đóng các yêu cầu không còn phù hợp.
target_text: The TTX showed that participants needed a clearer process for closing requests that were no longer relevant.

source_text: OPERA CIS giúp theo dõi liệu các đề nghị vẫn đang chờ phê duyệt của quốc gia chủ nhà hay đã sẵn sàng giao nhiệm vụ.
target_text: OPERA CIS helped track whether offers were still pending host-nation approval or ready for tasking.

source_text: Tham chiếu SASOP giúp nhóm điều chỉnh thủ tục hỗ trợ ASEAN với quy trình yêu cầu quốc gia của quốc gia bị ảnh hưởng.
target_text: SASOP references helped the team align ASEAN support procedures with the affected state's national request process.

source_text: SASOP Chapter VI được viện dẫn khi thảo luận cách thiết bị quân sự nên thông quan nhập cảnh và di chuyển tới nhiệm vụ được giao.
target_text: SASOP Chapter VI was cited when discussing how military equipment should clear entry and move to assigned tasks.

source_text: Nguyên tắc AADMER củng cố rằng hỗ trợ khu vực nên hỗ trợ lãnh đạo quốc gia và tăng cường hợp tác giữa các quốc gia thành viên.
target_text: AADMER principles reinforced that regional assistance should support national leadership and strengthen cooperation among member states.

source_text: Kinh nghiệm ARDEX giúp nhóm diễn tập thiết kế chuyển tiếp thực tế từ hoạt động ứng phó sang lập kế hoạch phục hồi sớm.
target_text: ARDEX experience helped the exercise team design realistic transitions from response operations to early recovery planning.

source_text: SME về quản lý thông tin khuyến nghị một hệ thống phân loại báo cáo đơn giản cho các giai đoạn thảm họa có khối lượng thông tin cao.
target_text: The SME on information management recommended a simple report triage system for high-volume disaster periods.

source_text: Thảo luận AAR nhấn mạnh nhu cầu báo cáo ngắn hơn, chủ nhiệm vụ rõ hơn và theo dõi quyết định tốt hơn.
target_text: AAR discussions highlighted the need for shorter briefings, clearer task owners, and better tracking of decisions.

source_text: GenAI hỗ trợ phân loại dịch thuật bằng cách xác định các báo cáo cần con người rà soát khẩn cấp trước khi phổ biến.
target_text: GenAI supported translation triage by identifying reports that needed urgent human review before dissemination.

source_text: LLM soạn bản tóm tắt báo cáo nơi trú ẩn, nhưng quản lý thông tin đã loại bỏ các con số chưa chắc chắn trước khi phát hành.
target_text: The LLM drafted a summary of shelter reports, but the information manager removed uncertain numbers before release.

source_text: Dữ liệu Sentinel-1 giúp các nhà lập kế hoạch xác định các đoạn đường ngập bị mây che khuất trong ảnh quang học.
target_text: Sentinel-1 data helped planners identify flooded road segments hidden beneath cloud cover in optical imagery.

source_text: Bản đồ Copernicus hỗ trợ so sánh báo cáo huyện chính thức với quan sát viễn thám độc lập.
target_text: Copernicus mapping supported the comparison of official district reports with independent remote-sensing observations.

source_text: Digital Twin cho thấy di chuyển một trung tâm hậu cần gần bờ biển hơn có thể cải thiện thời điểm giao hàng.
target_text: The Digital Twin showed that moving one logistics hub closer to the coast could improve delivery timing.

source_text: Hybrid Exercise cho phép các nhà lập kế hoạch từ xa kiểm tra quyết định chính sách trong khi các đội hiện trường thực hành tiếp nhận hàng.
target_text: The Hybrid Exercise allowed remote planners to test policy decisions while field teams practiced cargo reception.

source_text: Interoperability cải thiện sau khi nhóm thông tin công bố hướng dẫn ngắn về địa danh và định dạng dữ liệu.
target_text: Interoperability improved after the information team published a short guide on place names and data formats.

source_text: Information Overload giảm khi mỗi bộ phận chỉ nộp các quyết định cần thiết, thay đổi lớn và hạn chế then chốt.
target_text: Information Overload was reduced when each cell submitted only decisions needed, major changes, and critical constraints.

source_text: ToR làm rõ rằng sĩ quan liên lạc nên chia sẻ thông tin, không tự ý giao nhiệm vụ tài sản ngoài các kênh đã phê duyệt.
target_text: The ToR clarified that liaison officers should share information, not independently task assets outside approved channels.

source_text: Phát triển CONOPS bao gồm các kế hoạch nhánh cho đóng cảng, ùn tắc sân bay, tăng tải bệnh viện và lũ tái diễn.
target_text: CONOPS development included branch plans for port closure, airfield congestion, hospital surge, and renewed flooding.

source_text: NFP thông báo cho mạng lưới khu vực rằng hai đề nghị đã được chấp nhận cần thời gian đến được sửa đổi.
target_text: The NFP informed the regional network that two accepted offers needed revised arrival times.

source_text: Bộ phận lập kế hoạch sử dụng HADR để quyết định liệu khu công nghiệp bị lũ tàn phá có cần một ghi chú ưu tiên ngành cân bằng hay không.
target_text: The planning cell used HADR to decide whether the flood-damaged industrial estate needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: Bảng điều khiển Changi RHCC giúp cho thấy năng lực đối tác nào có thể đến trong hai mươi bốn giờ tới.
target_text: The Changi RHCC dashboard helped show which partner capabilities could arrive within the next twenty-four hours.

source_text: Hỗ trợ máy bay của US INDOPACOM chỉ được xem xét sau khi các phương án đường bộ và đường biển được đánh giá là không đủ.
target_text: US INDOPACOM aircraft support was considered only after road and sea options were assessed as insufficient.

source_text: Các quan sát viên CFE-DM khuyến nghị bộ phận điều phối ghi lại lý do từng lựa chọn tác nghiệp lớn được đưa ra.
target_text: CFE-DM observers recommended that the coordination cell record why each major operational choice was made.

source_text: AHA Centre giúp điều chỉnh thông điệp hỗ trợ khu vực để các đối tác không gửi thông tin mâu thuẫn cho quốc gia bị ảnh hưởng.
target_text: The AHA Centre helped align regional support messaging so partners did not send conflicting information to the affected state.

source_text: UN OCHA hỗ trợ một cuộc thảo luận ưu tiên nhân đạo tách nhu cầu cứu sinh tức thời khỏi các quan ngại phục hồi sớm.
target_text: UN OCHA supported a humanitarian priorities discussion that separated immediate life-saving needs from early recovery concerns.

source_text: Dữ liệu đánh giá ASEAN-ERAT giúp NDMO hoàn thiện những xã nào cần xác minh bổ sung.
target_text: ASEAN-ERAT assessment data helped the NDMO refine which communes needed additional verification.

source_text: Điều phối viên ACMC giúp người tham gia thực hành giải thích các phương án hỗ trợ quân sự cho người ra quyết định dân sự bằng ngôn ngữ dễ hiểu.
target_text: ACMC facilitators helped participants practice explaining military support options to civilian decision-makers in plain language.

source_text: Bản đồ phơi nhiễm PDC giúp ưu tiên thông điệp cảnh báo cho các cộng đồng gần sông, sườn dốc và đường hư hỏng.
target_text: PDC exposure maps helped prioritize warning messages for communities near rivers, steep slopes, and damaged roads.

source_text: WHO khuyên các đối tác y tế đưa sức khỏe tâm thần và hỗ trợ tâm lý xã hội vào kế hoạch tiếp cận nơi trú ẩn.
target_text: WHO advised health partners to include mental health and psychosocial support in shelter outreach plans.

source_text: WFP lập kế hoạch giao lương thực dự phòng cho các cộng đồng có thể bị cô lập nếu MSR đóng lại.
target_text: WFP planned contingency food deliveries for communities that could be cut off if the MSR closed again.

source_text: ISCG đề nghị các đối tác cập nhật ước tính người hưởng lợi trước khi khuyến nghị mở rộng hỗ trợ nơi trú ẩn.
target_text: The ISCG asked partners to update beneficiary estimates before recommending an expansion of shelter assistance.

source_text: USAID BHA phối hợp với các nhà tài trợ khác để tránh tài trợ các hoạt động chồng lấn trong cùng trung tâm sơ tán.
target_text: USAID BHA coordinated with other donors to avoid funding overlapping activities in the same evacuation centres.

source_text: Thảo luận ADMM-Plus nhấn mạnh khả năng tương tác thực tế giữa các lực lượng quốc phòng trong ứng phó thảm họa, không chỉ đối thoại chiến lược.
target_text: ADMM-Plus discussions emphasized practical interoperability between defence forces during disaster response, not only strategic dialogue.

source_text: EWG on HADR xác định đào tạo liên lạc là nhu cầu lặp lại qua nhiều cuộc diễn tập khu vực.
target_text: The EWG on HADR identified liaison training as a recurring need across multiple regional exercises.

source_text: Điều phối INSARAG giúp quốc gia chủ nhà phân chia công việc cứu hộ giữa các đội có năng lực nhẹ, trung bình và nặng.
target_text: INSARAG coordination helped the host nation divide rescue work between teams with light, medium, and heavy capabilities.

source_text: ASEAN Secretariat chia sẻ tóm tắt cuộc họp cuối cùng với các quốc gia thành viên và quan sát viên diễn tập.
target_text: The ASEAN Secretariat shared the final meeting summary with member states and exercise observers.

source_text: Thành viên AMRG on HADR so sánh tốc độ các gói lực lượng khác nhau có thể triển khai sau yêu cầu chính thức.
target_text: AMRG on HADR members compared how quickly different force packages could deploy after official request.

source_text: Nhân sự SAF tư vấn về luồng hàng an toàn khi xe nâng, xe buýt, đội y tế và máy bay dùng chung không gian sân đỗ hạn chế.
target_text: SAF personnel advised on safe cargo flow when forklifts, buses, medical teams, and aircraft shared limited apron space.

source_text: Hỗ trợ PLA được điều phối thông qua MNCC để nhiệm vụ kỹ thuật vẫn phù hợp với ưu tiên quốc gia.
target_text: PLA support was coordinated through the MNCC so engineering tasks remained aligned with national priorities.

source_text: JOCCA duy trì một ma trận hỗ trợ khu vực thể hiện đề nghị, trạng thái giao nhiệm vụ và khoảng trống điều phối còn lại.
target_text: JOCCA maintained a regional assistance matrix that showed offers, tasking status, and remaining coordination gaps.

source_text: Lãnh đạo cứu hộ SCDF nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của quản lý mệt mỏi trong các hoạt động tìm kiếm kéo dài.
target_text: SCDF rescue leaders stressed the importance of fatigue management during extended search operations.

source_text: VINASARCOM xác nhận rằng chính quyền tỉnh nên báo cáo nhu cầu qua kênh quốc gia thay vì trực tiếp yêu cầu đội nước ngoài.
target_text: VINASARCOM confirmed that provincial authorities should report needs through national channels rather than directly requesting foreign teams.

source_text: Giám sát sông của VDDMA cho thấy đỉnh lũ sẽ đến các huyện hạ lưu muộn hơn dự kiến ban đầu.
target_text: VDDMA river monitoring showed that flood peaks would reach downstream districts later than originally expected.

source_text: Hỗ trợ VPA giúp mở lại một đoạn đường nối hai trung tâm sơ tán với bệnh viện gần nhất.
target_text: VPA support helped reopen a road segment that connected two evacuation centres with the nearest hospital.

source_text: MARD khuyên rằng lập kế hoạch cứu trợ nên tính đến nông dân mất công cụ, giống và thức ăn chăn nuôi.
target_text: MARD advised that relief planning should account for farmers who lost tools, seed, and livestock feed.

source_text: Cập nhật cầu của MOT cho phép các nhà lập kế hoạch đoàn xe chuyển hàng nặng sang tuyến an toàn hơn.
target_text: MOT bridge updates allowed convoy planners to shift heavy cargo onto safer routes.

source_text: MOH phối hợp với VAMS để so sánh báo cáo năng lực bệnh viện với dữ liệu chuyển bệnh bằng xe cứu thương.
target_text: MOH coordinated with VAMS to compare hospital capacity reports with ambulance transfer data.

source_text: Các đối tác DRRP khuyến nghị củng cố ban phòng chống thảm họa cộng đồng dựa trên khoảng trống được kịch bản bộc lộ.
target_text: DRRP partners recommended strengthening community disaster committees based on gaps revealed by the scenario.

source_text: Kinh phí QPT giúp duy trì thiết bị sơ tán địa phương được sử dụng trước khi hỗ trợ bên ngoài đến.
target_text: QPT funding helped maintain local evacuation equipment that was used before outside assistance arrived.

source_text: Tình nguyện viên VNRC xác định các hộ cần giấy tờ thay thế, hỗ trợ truy tìm gia đình và vật phẩm cứu trợ cơ bản.
target_text: VNRC volunteers identified households needing replacement documents, family tracing support, and basic relief items.

source_text: VAMS chia sẻ tóm tắt tăng tải bệnh viện trước cuộc họp điều phối cuối cùng của diễn tập.
target_text: VAMS shared a hospital surge summary before the final coordination meeting of the exercise.

source_text: Điều phối WoG giúp lãnh đạo kết nối các quyết định khẩn cấp với lập kế hoạch phục hồi cho giao thông, nông nghiệp và y tế công cộng.
target_text: WoG coordination helped leaders connect emergency decisions with recovery planning for transport, agriculture, and public health.

source_text: NDMO đóng yêu cầu đang chờ cuối cùng sau khi xác nhận chính quyền tỉnh không còn cần hỗ trợ bên ngoài bổ sung.
target_text: The NDMO closed the last pending request after confirming that provincial authorities no longer required additional external support.

source_text: Nhân viên CMCoord ghi lại bài học về cách yêu cầu năng lực quân sự mà không làm gián đoạn hệ thống điều phối nhân đạo.
target_text: CMCoord staff documented lessons on how to request military capabilities without disrupting humanitarian coordination systems.

source_text: NFP cập nhật cho các đối tác rằng quốc gia bị ảnh hưởng đã chấp nhận hỗ trợ xử lý nước nhưng từ chối thêm đội cứu hộ.
target_text: The NFP updated partners that the affected state had accepted water treatment support but declined additional rescue teams.

source_text: Một rà soát ngắn về Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] giúp nhân viên vô tuyến diễn giải đợt mưa tăng mạnh ban đêm mà không làm chậm danh sách ưu tiên đã hiệu chỉnh.
target_text: A short review of Capacity Building [Efforts to strengthen stakeholder response ability] helped radio operators interpret a night-time rainfall surge without delaying a corrected priority list.

source_text: หน่วยวางแผนนำ HADR [การช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมและการบรรเทาภัยพิบัติ] มาใช้เมื่อฝนที่กลับมาตกอีกครั้งทำให้การตัดสินใจมอบหมายงานตามปกติซับซ้อนขึ้น
target_text: The planning cell applied HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] when renewed rainfall made routine tasking decisions more complicated.

source_text: หน่วยตอบสนองระดับชาติขอให้ Changi RHCC [ศูนย์ประสานงาน HADR ระดับภูมิภาคชางงี] ช่วยประสานการสนับสนุนจากภูมิภาคที่กำลังเข้ามา
target_text: The national response cell asked the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] to help synchronize incoming regional support.

source_text: ระหว่างการประชุมประสานงานครั้งแรก US INDOPACOM [กองบัญชาการอินโด-แปซิฟิกของสหรัฐอเมริกา] ยืนยันว่ามีทางเลือกด้านการลำเลียงทางอากาศพร้อมใช้งาน
target_text: During the first coordination call, US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] confirmed that airlift options were available.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ภาคสนามใช้คำแนะนำจาก CFE-DM [ศูนย์ความเป็นเลิศด้านการจัดการภัยพิบัติและการช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรม] เพื่อปรับปรุงแผนพลเรือน-ทหารให้ละเอียดขึ้น
target_text: Field officers used guidance from CFE-DM [Center for Excellence in Disaster Management and Humanitarian Assistance] to refine the civil-military plan.

source_text: ข้อมูลล่าสุดจาก AHA Centre [ศูนย์ประสานงานอาเซียนเพื่อความช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมในการจัดการภัยพิบัติ] ให้รายละเอียดเพียงพอแก่เจ้าหน้าที่อำเภอในการจัดทำตารางความช่วยเหลือที่ชัดเจนขึ้นสำหรับพื้นที่คลังสินค้าระดับจังหวัด
target_text: The update from AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] gave district officers enough detail to produce a cleaner assistance matrix for the provincial warehouse area.

source_text: ลำดับความสำคัญด้านมนุษยธรรมประจำวันได้รับการจัดแนวผ่าน UN OCHA [สำนักงานสหประชาชาติเพื่อการประสานงานด้านมนุษยธรรม]
target_text: Daily humanitarian priorities were aligned through UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: สำหรับกลุ่มศูนย์พักพิงในโรงเรียน AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบดินถล่มเหนือทางเลี่ยงกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, AS [Affected State] gave the team a way to compare mudslides above the bypass with other response risks.

source_text: กลุ่มควบคุมการฝึกเชิญ ACMC [ศูนย์พลเรือน-ทหารออสเตรเลีย] มาให้คำแนะนำเกี่ยวกับการประสานงานที่นำโดยฝ่ายพลเรือน
target_text: The exercise control group invited ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] to advise on civilian-led coordination.

source_text: แผนที่การเผชิญน้ำท่วมจาก PDC [ศูนย์ภัยพิบัติแปซิฟิก] ช่วยให้นักวางแผนระบุหมู่บ้านที่มีแนวโน้มต้องอพยพ
target_text: Flood exposure maps from PDC [Pacific Disaster Center] helped planners identify villages likely to need evacuation.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่อำเภอปรึกษา WHO [องค์การอนามัยโลก] ระหว่างปรับเทียบรายงานศูนย์พักพิงกับข้อจำกัดด้านการเข้าถึงในชุมชนที่ราบน้ำท่วมถึง
target_text: District officials consulted WHO [World Health Organization] while reconciling shelter reports with access constraints in the floodplain settlements.

source_text: เสบียงอาหารฉุกเฉินถูกลำเลียงผ่านเครือข่ายโลจิสติกส์ของ WFP [โครงการอาหารโลก]
target_text: Emergency food rations were moved through WFP [World Food Programme] logistics networks.

source_text: ISCG [กลุ่มประสานงานระหว่างภาคส่วน] ให้ข้อมูลอัปเดตที่เจาะจงเกี่ยวกับรายงานการเข้าถึงที่ขัดแย้งกัน ซึ่งช่วยให้ทีมปรับลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับชุมชนเกาะได้
target_text: ISCG [Intersectoral Coordination Group] contributed a focused update on conflicting access reports, which helped the team adjust priorities for the island communities.

source_text: ในทางเลี่ยงถนนบนเขา USAID BHA [สำนักงานความช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมขององค์การเพื่อการพัฒนาระหว่างประเทศแห่งสหรัฐอเมริกา] ช่วยให้นักวางแผนทางการแพทย์เปลี่ยนจำนวนผู้มาถึงศูนย์พักพิงที่เพิ่มขึ้นอย่างฉับพลันให้เป็นวงจรรับฟังความคิดเห็นชุมชนที่แข็งแรงขึ้น
target_text: In the hill road bypass, USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] helped medical planners turn a sudden increase in shelter arrivals into a stronger community feedback loop.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ปฏิบัติการใช้คำแนะนำจาก ADMM-Plus [การประชุมรัฐมนตรีกลาโหมอาเซียนบวก] เพื่อแก้ประเด็นว่าการสนับสนุนจะคงอยู่ได้นานเพียงใดโดยไม่ทำให้ความช่วยเหลือไปยังศูนย์โลจิสติกส์ส่วนหน้าล่าช้า
target_text: Operational staff used advice from ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] to resolve how long support could be sustained without delaying assistance to the forward logistics hub.

source_text: กระดานมอบหมายงานบันทึก EWG on HADR [คณะทำงานผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้านการช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมและการบรรเทาภัยพิบัติ] เป็นผู้ประสานงานหลักสำหรับการเตือนภัยชุมชนในแนวถนนภูเขา
target_text: The tasking board recorded EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] as the key coordination contact for community warning in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: หน่วยตอบสนองเปรียบเทียบรายงานท้องถิ่นกับคำแนะนำจาก INSARAG [กลุ่มที่ปรึกษาระหว่างประเทศด้านการค้นหาและกู้ภัย] ก่อนปรับปรุงลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับเครือข่ายศูนย์อพยพ
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] before updating priorities for the evacuation centre network.

source_text: ระหว่างระยะการประเมินอย่างรวดเร็ว AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] กำหนดแนวทางให้ทีมจัดระเบียบรายงานจากหมู่บ้านท้ายน้ำ
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, AS [Affected State] shaped how teams organized reports from the downstream villages.

source_text: AMRG on HADR [กลุ่มกองทัพอาเซียนพร้อมปฏิบัติการด้าน HADR] ให้ข้อมูลอัปเดตที่เจาะจงเกี่ยวกับความล่าช้าในการเปิดเส้นทาง ซึ่งช่วยให้ทีมปรับลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับฐานเตรียมการชั่วคราว
target_text: AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR] contributed a focused update on road clearance delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ท่าเรือนำ SAF [กองทัพสิงคโปร์] เข้าร่วมการหารือ เพราะหมู่บ้านประมงชายฝั่งต้องการบันทึกลำดับความสำคัญรายภาคส่วนที่สมดุล
target_text: port authorities brought SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] into the discussion because coastal fishing villages needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: ทีมกลับมาทบทวน AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] เพราะตัวเลขประชากรหมู่บ้านที่ขัดแย้งกันส่งผลต่อวิธีที่นักวางแผนจังหวัดวางแผนทีมประเมินขนาดเล็กลง
target_text: The team revisited AS [Affected State] because conflicting village population figures affected how provincial planners planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: JOCCA [ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการและประสานงานร่วมแห่งอาเซียน] ช่วยถ่ายทอดลำดับความสำคัญด้านการเตือนภัยชุมชนจากอำเภอชายฝั่งไปยังเจ้าหน้าที่ประสานงานระดับภูมิภาค
target_text: JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] helped relay community warning priorities from the coastal district to regional liaison officers.

source_text: หน่วยตอบสนองเปรียบเทียบรายงานท้องถิ่นกับคำแนะนำจาก SCDF [กองกำลังป้องกันพลเรือนสิงคโปร์] ก่อนปรับปรุงลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับศูนย์โลจิสติกส์ส่วนหน้า
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] before updating priorities for the forward logistics hub.

source_text: ระหว่างระยะการประเมินอย่างรวดเร็ว AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] กำหนดแนวทางให้ทีมจัดระเบียบรายงานจากแนวถนนภูเขา
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, AS [Affected State] shaped how teams organized reports from the mountain road corridor.

source_text: VDDMA [หน่วยงานจัดการภัยพิบัติและเขื่อนของเวียดนาม] ให้ข้อมูลอัปเดตที่เจาะจงเกี่ยวกับรายงานการเข้าถึงที่ขัดแย้งกัน ซึ่งช่วยให้ทีมปรับลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับเครือข่ายศูนย์อพยพ
target_text: VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] contributed a focused update on conflicting access reports, which helped the team adjust priorities for the evacuation centre network.

source_text: เมื่อเกิดดินถล่มเหนือทางเลี่ยง VPA [กองทัพประชาชนเวียดนาม] ทำงานร่วมกับผู้นำชุมชนเกี่ยวกับบันทึกลำดับความสำคัญรายภาคส่วนที่สมดุลบนลานขนส่งสินค้าของสนามบิน
target_text: When mudslides above the bypass emerged, VPA [Vietnam People's Army] worked with community leaders on a balanced sector priority note in the airport cargo apron.

source_text: สำหรับเขตชลประทานท้ายน้ำ AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบการปันส่วนเชื้อเพลิงชั่วคราวกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the downstream irrigation zone, AS [Affected State] gave the team a way to compare a temporary fuel ration with other response risks.

source_text: MOT [กระทรวงคมนาคม] ใช้ข้อมูลอัปเดตจากห้องปฏิบัติการอำเภอเพื่อตัดสินใจว่าควรออกคำเตือนถนนใดก่อนขบวนรถช่วงเย็น
target_text: MOT [Ministry of Transport] used district operations room updates to decide which road warnings should be issued before the evening convoy.

source_text: หน่วยตอบสนองเปรียบเทียบรายงานท้องถิ่นกับคำแนะนำจาก MOH [กระทรวงสาธารณสุข] ก่อนปรับปรุงลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับชุมชนเกาะ
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from MOH [Ministry of Health] before updating priorities for the island communities.

source_text: ระหว่างระยะการประเมินอย่างรวดเร็ว AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] ตรวจทานรายงานอำเภอชายฝั่งก่อนรับการสนับสนุนระหว่างประเทศเพิ่มเติม
target_text: During the rapid assessment phase, the AS [Affected State] reviewed coastal district reports before accepting additional international support.

source_text: QPT [กองทุนชุมชนเพื่อการป้องกันภัยพิบัติทางธรรมชาติ] ให้ข้อมูลอัปเดตที่เจาะจงเกี่ยวกับความล่าช้าในการเปิดเส้นทาง ซึ่งช่วยให้ทีมปรับลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับศูนย์โลจิสติกส์ส่วนหน้า
target_text: QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] contributed a focused update on road clearance delays, which helped the team adjust priorities for the forward logistics hub.

source_text: บันทึกภาคสนามจาก VNRC [สภากาชาดเวียดนาม] ช่วยลดความซ้ำซ้อนในการวางแผนสำหรับนิคมอุตสาหกรรมที่เสียหายจากน้ำท่วม นำไปสู่บันทึกลำดับความสำคัญรายภาคส่วนที่สมดุล
target_text: A field note from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] deconflicted planning for the flood-damaged industrial estate, leading to a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] กำหนดรูปแบบทีมประเมินที่เล็กลงเมื่อผู้จัดการคลังสินค้ายืนยันสภาพในแนวโลจิสติกส์ตะวันตก
target_text: AS [Affected State] shaped a smaller assessment team once warehouse managers confirmed conditions in the western logistics corridor.

source_text: ไทม์ไลน์การตอบสนองถูกปรับรอบ WoG [แนวทางทั้งรัฐบาล] เมื่อการขัดข้องของโทรคมนาคมส่งผลต่อชุมชนในหมู่บ้านท้ายน้ำ
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around WoG [Whole-of-Government] once telecommunications outages affected communities in the downstream villages.

source_text: หน่วยตอบสนองเปรียบเทียบรายงานท้องถิ่นกับคำแนะนำจาก NDMO [สำนักงานจัดการภัยพิบัติแห่งชาติ] ก่อนปรับปรุงลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับฐานเตรียมการชั่วคราว
target_text: The response cell compared local reports with guidance from NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] before updating priorities for the temporary staging base.

source_text: ห้องปฏิบัติการอำเภอส่งผลการประเมินอย่างรวดเร็วไปยัง AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] ก่อนขอความช่วยเหลือจากพันธมิตรระดับภูมิภาค
target_text: The district operations room sent its rapid assessment findings to the AS [Affected State] before regional partners were asked for assistance.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ประสานงานเชื่อม Mil-Mil [การประสานงานระหว่างทหารกับทหาร] เข้ากับข้อความเตือนภัยภาษาท้องถิ่นหลังรายงานจากพื้นที่คลังสินค้าระดับจังหวัดเปลี่ยนไปข้ามคืน
target_text: liaison officers linked Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] to a local-language warning message after reports from the provincial warehouse area changed overnight.

source_text: บันทึกการประสานงานอ้างถึง Civ-Mil [การประสานงานพลเรือน-ทหาร] หลังการขัดข้องของโทรคมนาคมเผยให้เห็นช่องว่างในกระบวนการตอบสนอง
target_text: The coordination note referenced Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after telecommunications outages exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: ทีมกลับมาทบทวน AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] เพราะท่อลอดที่อุดตันใกล้ MSR ส่งผลต่อวิธีที่ผู้แทนผู้บริจาควางแผนทีมประเมินขนาดเล็กลง
target_text: The team revisited AS [Affected State] because a blocked culvert near the MSR affected how donor representatives planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: บันทึกภาคสนามจาก MNCC [ศูนย์ประสานงานข้ามชาติ] ช่วยลดความซ้ำซ้อนในการวางแผนสำหรับลานขนส่งสินค้าของสนามบิน นำไปสู่การเยี่ยมศูนย์พักพิงแบบเจาะจง
target_text: A field note from MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] deconflicted planning for the airport cargo apron, leading to a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: ที่ปรึกษาวิศวกรรมประสานงานกับ EOC [ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการฉุกเฉิน] หลังสินค้าบรรเทาทุกข์ค้างสะสมเสี่ยงทำให้การสนับสนุนเขตชลประทานท้ายน้ำสะดุด
target_text: engineering advisers coordinated with EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] after a backlog of relief cargo threatened to disrupt support for the downstream irrigation zone.

source_text: หน่วยวางแผนใช้ AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] เพื่อตัดสินใจว่าถนนเข้าท่าเรือต้องการชุดพิธีการศุลกากรที่เร็วขึ้นหรือไม่
target_text: The planning cell used AS [Affected State] to decide whether the port access road needed a faster customs package.

source_text: สำหรับพื้นที่ตั้งถิ่นฐานใหม่ตอนใต้ COP [ภาพสถานการณ์การปฏิบัติการร่วม] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบการปันส่วนเชื้อเพลิงชั่วคราวกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, COP [Common Operating Picture] gave the team a way to compare a temporary fuel ration with other response risks.

source_text: บันทึกการประสานงานอ้างถึง SAR [การค้นหาและกู้ภัย] หลังความเสียหายของสะพานเผยให้เห็นช่องว่างในกระบวนการตอบสนอง
target_text: The coordination note referenced SAR [Search and Rescue] after bridge damage exposed a gap in the response process.

source_text: ระหว่างการทำงานที่จุดรวมพลของตำบลห่างไกล USAR [การค้นหาและกู้ภัยในเขตเมือง] ช่วยแยกการดำเนินการเร่งด่วนออกจากการติดตามตามปกติ
target_text: During work on the remote commune assembly point, USAR [Urban Search and Rescue] helped separate urgent action from routine monitoring.

source_text: ไทม์ไลน์การตอบสนองถูกปรับรอบ MSAR [การค้นหาและกู้ภัยทางทะเล] เมื่อการขัดข้องของโทรคมนาคมส่งผลต่อชุมชนในอำเภอชายฝั่ง
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around MSAR [Maritime Search and Rescue] once telecommunications outages affected communities in the coastal district.

source_text: ในหมู่บ้านประมงชายฝั่ง CBRE [ผลกระทบทางเคมี ชีวภาพ รังสี และวัตถุระเบิด] ช่วยเปลี่ยนจำนวนผู้มาถึงศูนย์พักพิงที่เพิ่มขึ้นอย่างฉับพลันให้เป็นงานจัดหาน้ำที่ปฏิบัติได้จริง
target_text: In coastal fishing villages, CBRE [Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Explosive impact] helped convert a sudden increase in shelter arrivals into a practical water-supply task.

source_text: IOI [ประเด็นที่น่าสนใจ] กำหนดงานวิศวกรรมที่สมจริงขึ้นเมื่อที่ปรึกษาวิศวกรรมยืนยันสภาพในแนวดินถล่มพื้นที่สูง
target_text: IOI [Issues of Interest] shaped a more realistic engineering task once engineering advisers confirmed conditions in the upland landslide corridor.

source_text: หน่วยวางแผนใช้ WASH [น้ำ สุขาภิบาล และสุขอนามัย] เพื่อตัดสินใจว่าเมืองตลาดพื้นที่ต่ำต้องการบันทึกประกอบการตัดสินใจที่ง่ายขึ้นหรือไม่
target_text: The planning cell used WASH [Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene] to decide whether a low-lying market town needed a simpler decision brief.

source_text: สำหรับกลุ่มศูนย์พักพิงในโรงเรียน NFI [สิ่งของที่ไม่ใช่อาหาร] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบรายชื่อผู้รับประโยชน์ที่หายไปกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the school shelter cluster, NFI [Non-Food Items] gave the team a way to compare a missing beneficiary list with other response risks.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ปฏิบัติการใช้คำแนะนำจาก HOC [ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการด้านมนุษยธรรม] เพื่อแก้ประเด็นว่าการสนับสนุนจะคงอยู่ได้นานเพียงใดโดยไม่ทำให้ความช่วยเหลือไปยังฐานเตรียมการชั่วคราวล่าช้า
target_text: Operational staff used advice from HOC [Humanitarian Operations Centre] to resolve how long support could be sustained without delaying assistance to the temporary staging base.

source_text: สถานการณ์ที่จุดสะพานชั่วคราวทำให้ LCC [ศูนย์ประสานงานโลจิสติกส์] ต้องชี้แจงว่าฝนที่ตกหนักในเวลากลางคืนเปลี่ยนลำดับการตอบสนองหรือไม่
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required LCC [Logistics Coordination Centre] to clarify whether a night-time rainfall surge changed the response sequence.

source_text: เสมียนโลจิสติกส์ขอให้ AIC [ศูนย์บูรณาการทางอากาศ] ตรวจสอบการขาดแคลนทีมรถพยาบาลก่อนจัดสรรทรัพยากรไปยังศูนย์บัญชาการอำเภอ
target_text: logistics clerks asked AIC [Air Integration Centre] to verify a shortage of ambulance crews before committing resources to the district command post.

source_text: ทีมตอบสนองทบทวน MASCAS [เหตุการณ์ผู้บาดเจ็บจำนวนมาก] หลังจำนวนผู้มาถึงศูนย์พักพิงที่เพิ่มขึ้นอย่างฉับพลันเผยให้เห็นจุดอ่อนในการวางแผนสำหรับทางเลี่ยงถนนบนเขา
target_text: The response team reviewed MASCAS [Mass Casualty Incident] after a sudden increase in shelter arrivals exposed a weakness in planning for the hill road bypass.

source_text: เมื่อทีมสาธารณสุขรายงานข้อจำกัดน้ำหนักถนนที่ไม่แน่นอน Mutual Recognition [ข้อตกลงรับรองร่วมสำหรับทีม USAR] กลายเป็นจุดอ้างอิงสำหรับเส้นทางขบวนรถที่ปลอดภัยขึ้น
target_text: When public health teams reported uncertain road weight limits, Mutual Recognition [Certification agreement for USAR teams] became the reference point for a safer convoy route.

source_text: การทบทวน APOD [ท่าอากาศยานปลายทางขนถ่าย] อย่างสั้นช่วยให้หัวหน้าการประเมินตีความกลุ่มผู้ป่วยไข้ได้โดยไม่ทำให้รายการลำดับความสำคัญที่แก้ไขแล้วล่าช้า
target_text: A short review of APOD [Aerial Port of Disembarkation] helped assessment leads interpret a cluster of fever cases without delaying a corrected priority list.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่อำเภอเชื่อม SPOD [ท่าเรือปลายทางขนถ่าย] เข้ากับพื้นที่ค้นหาที่แคบลงหลังรายงานจากหมู่บ้านเกาะกลางแม่น้ำเปลี่ยนไปข้ามคืน
target_text: district officers linked SPOD [Sea Port of Disembarkation] to a narrower search area after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: ระหว่างการทำงานในแนวอพยพตอนเหนือ MSR [เส้นทางส่งกำลังหลัก] ช่วยแยกการดำเนินการเร่งด่วนออกจากการติดตามตามปกติ
target_text: During work on the northern evacuation belt, MSR [Main Supply Route] helped separate urgent action from routine monitoring.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ป้องกันพลเรือนใช้ CIQ [ศุลกากร ตรวจคนเข้าเมือง และกักกัน] เมื่อการตรวจสะพานที่ล่าช้าทำให้การวางแผนสำหรับพื้นที่คลังสินค้าระดับจังหวัดคาดการณ์ได้ยากขึ้น
target_text: civil defence staff applied CIQ [Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine] when a delayed bridge inspection made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: ทีมตอบสนองทบทวน MCDA [ทรัพยากรทหารและป้องกันพลเรือน] หลังท่อลอดที่อุดตันใกล้ MSR เผยให้เห็นจุดอ่อนในการวางแผนสำหรับจุดข้ามเรือเฟอร์รีที่เสียหาย
target_text: The response team reviewed MCDA [Military and Civil Defence Assets] after a blocked culvert near the MSR exposed a weakness in planning for the damaged ferry crossing.

source_text: เมื่อเจ้าหน้าที่ประสานงานรายงานว่ารถยกมีจำกัด HuMOCC [แนวคิดการประสานงานปฏิบัติการมนุษยธรรม-ทหาร] กลายเป็นจุดอ้างอิงสำหรับรายการลำดับความสำคัญที่แก้ไขแล้ว
target_text: When liaison officers reported limited forklift availability, HuMOCC [Humanitarian-Military Operational Coordination Concept] became the reference point for a corrected priority list.

source_text: การทบทวน DVI [การพิสูจน์เอกลักษณ์ผู้เสียชีวิตจากภัยพิบัติ] อย่างสั้นช่วยให้ผู้จัดการข้อมูลตีความสินค้าบรรเทาทุกข์ค้างสะสมได้โดยไม่ทำให้พื้นที่ค้นหาที่แคบลงล่าช้า
target_text: A short review of DVI [Disaster Victim Identification] helped information managers interpret a backlog of relief cargo without delaying a narrower search area.

source_text: หลังดินถล่มเหนือทางเลี่ยง LEMA [หน่วยงานจัดการเหตุฉุกเฉินท้องถิ่น] ช่วยจัดแนวเสมียนโลจิสติกส์รอบข้อความเตือนภัยภาษาท้องถิ่น
target_text: After mudslides above the bypass, LEMA [Local Emergency Management Authority] helped align logistics clerks around a local-language warning message.

source_text: ไทม์ไลน์การตอบสนองถูกปรับรอบ Ex COORES [การฝึกการตอบสนองแบบประสานงาน] เมื่อความเสียหายของสะพานส่งผลต่อชุมชนในแนวถนนภูเขา
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Ex COORES [Exercise Coordinated Response] once bridge damage affected communities in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: ทีมกลับมาทบทวน TTX [การฝึกบนโต๊ะ] เพราะไฟฟ้าดับที่ EOC ส่งผลต่อวิธีที่ที่ปรึกษาวิศวกรรมวางแผนทีมประเมินขนาดเล็กลง
target_text: The team revisited TTX [Table-Top Exercise] because a power outage at the EOC affected how engineering advisers planned a smaller assessment team.

source_text: ในนิคมอุตสาหกรรมที่เสียหายจากน้ำท่วม OPERA CIS [ระบบสารสนเทศคอมพิวเตอร์สำหรับการแบ่งปันข้อมูล] ช่วยเปลี่ยนการตรวจสะพานที่ล่าช้าให้เป็นการเยี่ยมศูนย์พักพิงแบบเจาะจง
target_text: In the flood-damaged industrial estate, OPERA CIS [Computer Information System for information sharing] helped convert a delayed bridge inspection into a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: SASOP [ขั้นตอนปฏิบัติมาตรฐานสำหรับการจัดเตรียมสำรองระดับภูมิภาค] กำหนดคำขอเคลื่อนย้ายทางอากาศฉบับปรับปรุงเมื่อผู้วางแผนจังหวัดยืนยันสภาพในแนวโลจิสติกส์ตะวันตก
target_text: SASOP [Standard Operating Procedures for Regional Standby Arrangements] shaped a revised air movement request once provincial planners confirmed conditions in the western logistics corridor.

source_text: หน่วยวางแผนใช้ SASOP Chapter VI [หมวดที่กำกับการอำนวยความสะดวกและการใช้ทรัพยากรทหาร] เพื่อตัดสินใจว่าหมู่บ้านประมงชายฝั่งต้องการชุดพิธีการศุลกากรที่เร็วขึ้นหรือไม่
target_text: The planning cell used SASOP Chapter VI [Section governing facilitation and utilization of military assets] to decide whether coastal fishing villages needed a faster customs package.

source_text: สำหรับแนวดินถล่มพื้นที่สูง AADMER [ความตกลงอาเซียนว่าด้วยการจัดการภัยพิบัติและการตอบสนองฉุกเฉิน] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบสินค้าบรรเทาทุกข์ค้างสะสมกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the upland landslide corridor, AADMER [ASEAN Agreement on Disaster Management and Emergency Response] gave the team a way to compare a backlog of relief cargo with other response risks.

source_text: บันทึกสรุปการประสานงานกรอบดินถล่มเหนือทางเลี่ยงผ่าน ARDEX [การฝึกจำลองการตอบสนองฉุกเฉินภัยพิบัติระดับภูมิภาคอาเซียน] เพื่อให้ผู้นำอนุมัติทีมประเมินขนาดเล็กลงได้
target_text: The coordination brief framed mudslides above the bypass through ARDEX [ASEAN Regional Disaster Emergency Response Simulation Exercise] so leaders could approve a smaller assessment team.

source_text: ทีมกลับมาทบทวน SME [ผู้เชี่ยวชาญเฉพาะเรื่อง] เพราะการปันส่วนเชื้อเพลิงชั่วคราวส่งผลต่อวิธีที่ผู้จัดการคลังสินค้าวางแผนการเยี่ยมศูนย์พักพิงแบบเจาะจง
target_text: The team revisited SME [Subject Matter Expert] because a temporary fuel ration affected how warehouse managers planned a targeted shelter visit.

source_text: บนลานขนส่งสินค้าของสนามบิน AAR [การทบทวนหลังปฏิบัติการ] ช่วยเปลี่ยนความล่าช้าจากขบวนรถกลับลำให้เป็นคำขอเคลื่อนย้ายทางอากาศฉบับปรับปรุง
target_text: In the airport cargo apron, AAR [After Action Review] helped convert a convoy turnaround delay into a revised air movement request.

source_text: GenAI [ปัญญาประดิษฐ์เชิงกำเนิด] กำหนดชุดพิธีการศุลกากรที่เร็วขึ้นเมื่อผู้แทนผู้บริจาคยืนยันสภาพในเขตชลประทานท้ายน้ำ
target_text: GenAI [Generative AI] shaped a faster customs package once donor representatives confirmed conditions in the downstream irrigation zone.

source_text: หน่วยวางแผนใช้ LLM [แบบจำลองภาษาขนาดใหญ่] เพื่อตัดสินใจว่าถนนเข้าท่าเรือต้องการบันทึกลำดับความสำคัญรายภาคส่วนที่สมดุลหรือไม่
target_text: The planning cell used LLM [Large Language Model] to decide whether the port access road needed a balanced sector priority note.

source_text: สำหรับพื้นที่ตั้งถิ่นฐานใหม่ตอนใต้ Sentinel-1 [โครงการถ่ายภาพดาวเทียม] ให้ทีมมีวิธีเปรียบเทียบเครื่องทวนสัญญาณวิทยุที่เสียหายกับความเสี่ยงอื่นในการตอบสนอง
target_text: For the southern resettlement area, Sentinel-1 [Satellite imaging program] gave the team a way to compare a damaged radio repeater with other response risks.

source_text: ไทม์ไลน์การตอบสนองถูกปรับรอบ Copernicus [โครงการถ่ายภาพดาวเทียม] เมื่อความเสียหายของสะพานส่งผลต่อชุมชนในห้องปฏิบัติการอำเภอ
target_text: The response timeline was adjusted around Copernicus [Satellite imaging program] once bridge damage affected communities in the district operations room.

source_text: ทีมกลับมาทบทวน Digital Twin [โครงการจำลองเสมือนที่เสนอเพื่อความแม่นยำของการจำลองสถานการณ์] เพราะไฟฟ้าดับที่ EOC ส่งผลต่อวิธีที่เจ้าหน้าที่คมนาคมวางแผนงานวิศวกรรมที่สมจริงขึ้น
target_text: The team revisited Digital Twin [Proposed virtual replica project for simulation accuracy] because a power outage at the EOC affected how transport officials planned a more realistic engineering task.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่ประสานงานใช้ Hybrid Exercise [รูปแบบที่ผสาน TTX เสมือนกับองค์ประกอบ FTX ภาคสนาม] เมื่อการปันส่วนเชื้อเพลิงชั่วคราวทำให้การวางแผนสำหรับหมู่บ้านเกาะกลางแม่น้ำคาดการณ์ได้ยากขึ้น
target_text: liaison officers applied Hybrid Exercise [Model combining virtual TTX and physical FTX components] when a temporary fuel ration made planning for river-island hamlets less predictable.

source_text: ทีมตอบสนองทบทวน Interoperability [ความสามารถของระบบต่าง ๆ ในการแลกเปลี่ยนข้อมูล] หลังความล่าช้าจากขบวนรถกลับลำเผยให้เห็นจุดอ่อนในการวางแผนสำหรับแนวอพยพตอนเหนือ
target_text: The response team reviewed Interoperability [Ability of different systems to exchange data] after a convoy turnaround delay exposed a weakness in planning for the northern evacuation belt.

source_text: เมื่อเสมียนโลจิสติกส์รายงานตัวเลขประชากรหมู่บ้านที่ขัดแย้งกัน Information Overload [ความท้าทายในการจัดการข้อมูลปริมาณมากช่วงผลกระทบสูงสุด] กลายเป็นจุดอ้างอิงสำหรับช่วงเวลาการกระจายของที่ปรับปรุงแล้ว
target_text: When logistics clerks reported conflicting village population figures, Information Overload [Challenge of managing high data volumes during peak impact] became the reference point for a revised distribution window.

source_text: การทบทวน ToR [ขอบเขตอำนาจหน้าที่] อย่างสั้นช่วยให้นักวางแผนทางการแพทย์ตีความรายงานล่าช้าเรื่องบ่อน้ำปนเปื้อนได้โดยไม่ทำให้การปล่อยสินค้าตามระยะล่าช้า
target_text: A short review of ToR [Terms of Reference] helped medical planners interpret late reports of contaminated wells without delaying a phased cargo release.

source_text: ทีมสาธารณสุขเชื่อม CONOPS [แนวคิดการปฏิบัติการ] เข้ากับบันทึกส่งมอบที่ดีขึ้นหลังรายงานจากเขตรับผิดชอบโรงพยาบาลตะวันออกเปลี่ยนไปข้ามคืน
target_text: public health teams linked CONOPS [Concept of Operations] to a better handover note after reports from the eastern hospital catchment changed overnight.

source_text: สถานการณ์ที่จุดสะพานชั่วคราวทำให้ NFP [จุดประสานงานแห่งชาติ] ต้องชี้แจงว่าน้ำขึ้นสูงใกล้ปากแม่น้ำเปลี่ยนลำดับการตอบสนองหรือไม่
target_text: The situation in the temporary bridge site required NFP [National Focal Point] to clarify whether high tide near the river mouth changed the response sequence.

source_text: หลังแผ่นดินไหว ทีม HADR [การช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมและการบรรเทาภัยพิบัติ] มุ่งเน้นความช่วยเหลือเพื่อรักษาชีวิตก่อนเปลี่ยนไปสู่การฟื้นฟูระยะแรก
target_text: After the earthquake, HADR [Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] teams focused on life-saving assistance before shifting to early recovery.

source_text: พันธมิตรระดับภูมิภาคประสานงานผ่าน Changi RHCC [ศูนย์ประสานงาน HADR ระดับภูมิภาคชางงี] เมื่อมีข้อเสนอสนับสนุนหลายรายการเข้ามาพร้อมกัน
target_text: Regional partners coordinated through the Changi RHCC [Changi Regional HADR Coordination Centre] when multiple offers of support arrived at once.

source_text: รัฐบาลที่ได้รับผลกระทบขอการสนับสนุนขนส่งยกหนักจาก US INDOPACOM [กองบัญชาการอินโด-แปซิฟิกของสหรัฐอเมริกา] สำหรับชุมชนภูเขาที่ถูกตัดขาด
target_text: The affected government requested heavy-lift support from US INDOPACOM [United States Indo-Pacific Command] for isolated mountain communities.

source_text: บันทึกประสานงานจาก PLA [กองทัพปลดปล่อยประชาชน] ชี้แจงว่าควรจัดลำดับข้อเสนอจากพันธมิตรอย่างไรก่อนที่การสนับสนุนจะเคลื่อนไปยังตำบลตอนเหนือ
target_text: A liaison note from PLA [People's Liberation Army] clarified how partner offers should be sequenced before partner support moved toward the northern communes.

source_text: ข้อมูลสถานการณ์ล่าสุดจาก AHA Centre [ศูนย์ประสานงานอาเซียนเพื่อความช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมในการจัดการภัยพิบัติ] ช่วยจัดแนวลำดับความสำคัญในการบรรเทาทุกข์ในหมู่พันธมิตรอาเซียน
target_text: Situation updates from the AHA Centre [ASEAN Coordinating Centre for Humanitarian Assistance on disaster management] helped align relief priorities across ASEAN partners.

source_text: กระทรวงของรัฐบาลและหน่วยงานมนุษยธรรมเข้าร่วมการประชุมประสานงานที่จัดโดย UN OCHA [สำนักงานสหประชาชาติเพื่อการประสานงานด้านมนุษยธรรม]
target_text: Government ministries and humanitarian agencies joined the coordination call hosted by UN OCHA [United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs].

source_text: ในอำเภอที่เสียหาย ASEAN-ERAT [ทีมประเมินและตอบสนองฉุกเฉินอาเซียน] ตรวจยืนยันความต้องการด้านที่พักพิงก่อนส่งสิ่งของเพิ่มเติม
target_text: In the damaged district, ASEAN-ERAT [ASEAN Emergency Response and Assessment Team] verified shelter needs before additional supplies were dispatched.

source_text: กระดานมอบหมายงานบันทึก ACMC [ศูนย์พลเรือน-ทหารออสเตรเลีย] เป็นผู้ประสานงานหลักสำหรับการสนับสนุนที่พักพิงในแนวถนนภูเขา
target_text: The tasking board recorded ACMC [Australian Civil-Military Centre] as the key coordination contact for shelter support in the mountain road corridor.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่อำเภอเชื่อม ToR [ขอบเขตอำนาจหน้าที่] เข้ากับช่วงเวลาการกระจายที่ปรับปรุงแล้วหลังรายงานจากหมู่บ้านเกาะกลางแม่น้ำเปลี่ยนไปข้ามคืน
target_text: district officers linked ToR [Terms of Reference] to a revised distribution window after reports from river-island hamlets changed overnight.

source_text: กลุ่มสุขภาพขอให้ WHO [องค์การอนามัยโลก] ทบทวนแผนเฝ้าระวังโรค
target_text: The health cluster asked WHO [World Health Organization] to review the disease surveillance plan.

source_text: หน่วยงานท้องถิ่นประสานงานกับ WFP [โครงการอาหารโลก] เพื่อส่งชุดอาหารไปยังศูนย์อพยพ
target_text: Local authorities coordinated with WFP [World Food Programme] to deliver food packages to evacuation centres.

source_text: เสมียนโลจิสติกส์ใช้ ToR [ขอบเขตอำนาจหน้าที่] เมื่อเศษซากที่ไม่ปลอดภัยใกล้คลังสินค้าทำให้การวางแผนสำหรับพื้นที่คลังสินค้าระดับจังหวัดคาดการณ์ได้ยากขึ้น
target_text: logistics clerks applied ToR [Terms of Reference] when unsafe debris near a warehouse made planning for the provincial warehouse area less predictable.

source_text: ทุนสนับสนุนที่พักพิงฉุกเฉินได้รับการทบทวนโดย USAID BHA [สำนักงานความช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมขององค์การเพื่อการพัฒนาระหว่างประเทศแห่งสหรัฐอเมริกา] ระหว่างการประชุมประสานงานผู้บริจาค
target_text: Emergency shelter grants were reviewed by USAID BHA [United States Agency for International Development, Bureau for Humanitarian Assistance] during the donor coordination meeting.

source_text: เจ้าหน้าที่กลาโหมระดับภูมิภาคหารือความพร้อมด้าน HADR ภายใต้กรอบ ADMM-Plus [การประชุมรัฐมนตรีกลาโหมอาเซียนบวก]
target_text: Regional defence officials discussed HADR readiness under the ADMM-Plus [ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting Plus] framework.

source_text: บทเรียนจาก EWG on HADR [คณะทำงานผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้านการช่วยเหลือด้านมนุษยธรรมและการบรรเทาภัยพิบัติ] ถูกเพิ่มลงในตารางประเมินผลการฝึก
target_text: Lessons from the EWG on HADR [Experts' Working Group on Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief] were added to the exercise evaluation matrix.

source_text: หัวหน้าทีมกู้ภัยตรวจคำแนะนำของ INSARAG [กลุ่มที่ปรึกษาระหว่างประเทศด้านการค้นหาและกู้ภัย] ก่อนมอบหมายพื้นที่ค้นหา
target_text: The rescue team leader checked INSARAG [International Search and Rescue Advisory Group] guidance before assigning search sectors.

source_text: บันทึกการประชุมถูกส่งผ่าน ASEAN Secretariat [หน่วยงานบริหารกลางของอาเซียน] เพื่อการเผยแพร่อย่างเป็นทางการ
target_text: Meeting notes were routed through the ASEAN Secretariat [Central administrative body for ASEAN] for official distribution.

source_text: หน่วยแพทย์และวิศวกรรมที่สามารถเคลื่อนกำลังได้ถูกจัดทำบัญชีโดย AMRG on HADR [กลุ่มกองทัพอาเซียนพร้อมปฏิบัติการด้าน HADR]
target_text: Deployable medical and engineering units were catalogued by the AMRG on HADR [ASEAN Militaries Ready Group on HADR].

source_text: ประเทศเจ้าภาพขอการสนับสนุนเครื่องกรองน้ำจาก SAF [กองทัพสิงคโปร์] หลังบ่อน้ำปนเปื้อน
target_text: The host nation requested water purification support from SAF [Singapore Armed Forces] after wells were contaminated.

source_text: อุปกรณ์วิศวกรรมจาก PLA [กองทัพปลดปล่อยประชาชน] ได้รับมอบหมายให้ฟื้นฟูการเข้าถึงจุดข้ามแม่น้ำ
target_text: Engineering equipment from the PLA [People's Liberation Army] was assigned to restore access to the river crossing.

source_text: การมอบหมายงานระดับภูมิภาครายวันได้รับการประสานผ่าน JOCCA [ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการและประสานงานร่วมแห่งอาเซียน] ในช่วงการตอบสนองสูงสุด
target_text: Daily regional tasking was coordinated through JOCCA [Joint Operations and Coordination Centre of ASEAN] during the peak response period.

source_text: ขั้นตอนการค้นหาโครงสร้างถล่มได้รับการสาธิตโดย SCDF [กองกำลังป้องกันพลเรือนสิงคโปร์] ระหว่างการฝึกภาคสนาม
target_text: Collapsed-structure search procedures were demonstrated by SCDF [Singapore Civil Defence Force] during the field drill.

source_text: ศูนย์บัญชาการแห่งชาติรายงานข้อเสนอระหว่างประเทศทั้งหมดต่อ VINASARCOM [คณะกรรมการอำนวยการแห่งชาติด้านการป้องกันพลเรือนของเวียดนาม]
target_text: The national command post reported all international offers to VINASARCOM [Vietnam's National Steering Committee for Civil Defense].

source_text: ลำดับความสำคัญด้านการป้องกันน้ำท่วมจาก VDDMA [หน่วยงานจัดการภัยพิบัติและเขื่อนของเวียดนาม] กำหนดการจัดสรรเครื่องสูบน้ำและกระสอบทราย
target_text: Flood defence priorities from VDDMA [Vietnam Disaster and Dyke Management Authority] shaped the allocation of pumps and sandbags.

source_text: การสนับสนุนซ่อมสะพานจัดให้โดยวิศวกรของ VPA [กองทัพประชาชนเวียดนาม] หลังเส้นทางส่งกำลังหลักใช้การไม่ได้
target_text: Bridge repair support was provided by VPA [Vietnam People's Army] engineers after the main supply route failed.

source_text: ข้อมูลความเสียหายทางการเกษตรจาก MARD [กระทรวงเกษตรและพัฒนาชนบท] สนับสนุนการวางแผนฟื้นฟูระยะแรก
target_text: Agricultural loss data from MARD [Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development] informed early recovery planning.

source_text: ข้อมูลอัปเดตการเปิดเส้นทางจาก MOT [กระทรวงคมนาคม] ถูกเพิ่มลงในภาพสถานการณ์การปฏิบัติการร่วม
target_text: Road clearance updates from MOT [Ministry of Transport] were added to the common operating picture.

source_text: ลำดับความสำคัญด้านการอพยพทางการแพทย์ได้รับอนุมัติโดย MOH [กระทรวงสาธารณสุข] ก่อนเฮลิคอปเตอร์ออกบิน
target_text: Medical evacuation priorities were approved by MOH [Ministry of Health] before helicopters launched.

source_text: พันธมิตรฟื้นฟูภายใต้ DRRP [หุ้นส่วนลดความเสี่ยงภัยพิบัติของเวียดนาม] ระบุตำบลลำดับความสำคัญสำหรับโครงการเสริมความยืดหยุ่น
target_text: Recovery partners under DRRP [Vietnam Disaster Risk Reduction Partnership] identified priority communes for resilience programming.

source_text: ข้อความเตรียมพร้อมที่สนับสนุนโดย QPT [กองทุนชุมชนเพื่อการป้องกันภัยพิบัติทางธรรมชาติ] เข้าถึงครัวเรือนในพื้นที่เสี่ยงดินถล่ม
target_text: Preparedness messaging supported by QPT [Community Fund for Natural Disaster Prevention] reached households in landslide-prone areas.

source_text: ทีมปฐมพยาบาลจาก VNRC [สภากาชาดเวียดนาม] ช่วยผู้อพยพสูงอายุที่ศูนย์พักพิงในโรงเรียน
target_text: First aid teams from VNRC [Vietnam Red Cross] assisted elderly evacuees at the school shelter.

source_text: รายงานความพร้อมของโรงพยาบาลจาก VAMS [กรมบริการทางการแพทย์ของเวียดนาม] ถูกแบ่งปันระหว่างการบรรยายสรุปสุขภาพช่วงเย็น
target_text: Hospital readiness reports from VAMS [Vietnam Administration of Medical Service] were shared during the evening health briefing.

source_text: การส่งมอบงานปฏิบัติการใช้รูปแบบ WoG [แนวทางทั้งรัฐบาล] เพื่อรวมข้อมูลอัปเดตของอำเภอชายฝั่งจากเจ้าหน้าที่คมนาคม สาธารณสุข และกลาโหม
target_text: The operational handover used a WoG [Whole-of-Government] format to combine coastal district updates from transport, health, and defence officials.

source_text: พันธมิตรระหว่างประเทศรอให้ NDMO [สำนักงานจัดการภัยพิบัติแห่งชาติ] ยืนยันรายการความต้องการอย่างเป็นทางการ
target_text: International partners waited for the NDMO [National Disaster Management Office] to confirm the official needs list.

source_text: เมื่อข้อมูลอัปเดตจากเมืองหลวงจังหวัดขัดแย้งกัน CMCoord [การประสานงานพลเรือน-ทหาร] ให้นักวางแผนมีวิธีที่ชัดเจนขึ้นในการเปรียบเทียบลำดับความสำคัญ
target_text: When updates from the provincial capital conflicted, CMCoord [Civil-Military Coordination] gave planners a clearer way to compare priorities.

source_text: นักวางแผนทบทวน Mil-Mil [การประสานงานระหว่างทหารกับทหาร] ก่อนมอบหมายความรับผิดชอบในการกระจายสิ่งของบรรเทาทุกข์ระหว่างรอบประสานงานช่วงเช้า
target_text: Planners reviewed Mil-Mil [Military-to-Military coordination] before assigning responsibility for relief distribution during the morning coordination cycle.

source_text: ทีมตอบสนองทบทวน Civ-Mil [การประสานงานพลเรือน-ทหาร] หลังเครื่องทวนสัญญาณวิทยุที่เสียหายเผยให้เห็นจุดอ่อนในการวางแผนสำหรับจุดสะพานชั่วคราว
target_text: The response team reviewed Civ-Mil [Civilian-Military coordination] after a damaged radio repeater exposed a weakness in planning for the temporary bridge site.

source_text: เมื่อทีมสาธารณสุขรายงานน้ำขึ้นสูงใกล้ปากแม่น้ำ AS [รัฐที่ได้รับผลกระทบ] กลายเป็นจุดอ้างอิงสำหรับพื้นที่ค้นหาที่แคบลง
target_text: When public health teams reported high tide near the river mouth, AS [Affected State] became the reference point for a narrower search area.

source_text: MNCC [ศูนย์ประสานงานข้ามชาติ] ให้บริบทที่ขาดหายไปหลังหัวหน้าการประเมินตั้งคำถามต่อรายงานจากทางเลี่ยงถนนบนเขา
target_text: MNCC [Multi-National Coordination Centre] provided the missing context after assessment leads questioned reports from the hill road bypass.

source_text: รายงานจากอำเภอถึง EOC [ศูนย์ปฏิบัติการฉุกเฉิน] ก่อนการบรรยายสรุประดับชาติเริ่มขึ้น
target_text: District reports reached the EOC [Emergency Operations Centre] before the national briefing began.

source_text: จังหวัดยื่น RFA [คำขอความช่วยเหลือ] สำหรับหน่วยบำบัดน้ำและทีมแพทย์เคลื่อนที่
target_text: The province submitted an RFA [Request for Assistance] for water treatment units and mobile medical teams.
